meta.title: Ability Shop
meta.subtitle: Wario's Warehouse — Training Wing
meta.warioPitch: Wario does not 'teach' for coin anymore. Training is paid in Ability Points, earned by levelling. Wario is furious about this. No refunds, no lawsuits, no exceptions.
meta.note: Abilities are unlocked with Ability Points (AP), not gold. AP is auto-calculated from each character's XP level - see data/abilityPoints.json and tools/build_ability_points.py. The legacy `price` field below is retained for history only and is NOT used by the shop.
meta.source: Liberated Toads faction XP docket; original Training Wing abilities
meta.apCostRule: Shared pool costs: levels 1-4 = 1 AP, 5-8 = 2 AP, 9-12 = 3 AP, 13+ = 4 AP
meta.trainingRestriction: Core Liberated Toad docket only; Waluigi and Mole excluded; underlevel training permitted with lawful-conduct drawback.
meta.coreDocketModules: Removed pending hand-curated replacement; no generic generated entries are published.
meta.deduplication: Removed redundant toad_original entries; docket entries are the single canonical set of 100 original items, with descriptions matched to their names.

abilities.description: Restore a number of spell slots equal to your Intelligence modifier on short rest.

abilities.name: Chain Strike
abilities.description: Deal an additional weapon attack as part of a full attack action.
abilities.apReason: Chain Strike adds significant combat flexibility for a small cost.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters benefit from improved combat techniques early on.

rules.effect: On a full attack action, make an additional weapon attack with disadvantage. This ends when you miss with your first attack.
rules.drawback: If the first attack misses, all subsequent attacks are made at disadvantage.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting an extra punch in your glove—what a steal!

abilities.name: Rapid Strikes
abilities.description: Make two additional melee attacks as a bonus action, but deal no extra damage.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable combat edge at level one without being overpowered.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at level one to give new Fighters an early edge in combat.

rules.effect: On activation, make two additional melee attacks. The attacks deal no extra damage but may hit a different target each time.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you have previously used your Action Surge or Extra Attack this turn.

abilities.warioNote: Rapid Strikes? It's like getting in two extra hits, but don't expect them to pack much punch. Still, it's better than nothing!

abilities.name: Raging Strike
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage on your first attack of the turn.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for a level 1 fighter to ensure their first strike counts.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters often start with basic combat techniques they can immediately apply.

rules.effect: On your first attack action of the turn, deal an extra 1d6 damage. This effect ends if you miss with that attack.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per round.

abilities.warioNote: Raging Strike? More like 'Rushing Strike' if you ask me. But hey, it's free!

abilities.name: Rapid Shield Bash
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage with shield bash as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: This is a reliable edge that supports both offensive and defensive play, unlocking at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters can use their reaction to gain immediate offensive advantage at level 1.

rules.effect: When you hit a creature with a shield bash, deal an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage. This ends if the target moves more than 5 feet away.
rules.drawback: You must be wielding a shield and have proficiency in shields to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single Ability Point? You get extra damage AND you don't even have to wait your turn! What more could you ask for from Wario's Training Wing?

abilities.name: Runeblade Surge
abilities.description: Temporarily empower your weapon with runes, granting +2d6 damage and vulnerability to nonlethal damage.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for early levels, providing both offensive enhancement and a drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Fights need a reliable way to enhance their attacks early in the game.

rules.effect: Until concentration is lost, your melee weapon deals an additional 2d6 damage and you are vulnerable to nonlethal damage.
rules.drawback: Concentration must be maintained; otherwise, the runes fade and you must reapply them.

abilities.warioNote: These runes are no gimmick! For just one AP, you get +2d6 damage until you run out of steam. But don’t expect to cast them in a crowd—concentration’s a must!

abilities.name: Fortify Shield
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to AC as long as you are wielding a shield.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a reliable edge at the start of combat, and this defensive boost is essential for all fighters.
abilities.levelReason: A basic defensive ability for any fighter to protect themselves immediately.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a shield.
rules.drawback: Cannot activate if you already have an active feature that enhances your AC.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single AP? Fortify your shield and turn it into a fortress! Who needs armor when you've got Wario's shield?

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Smash an opponent with your shield, dealing force damage and knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge in close combat at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters begin training in basic weapon techniques early.

rules.effect: MELEE WEAPON ATTACK: On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 8 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the save is failed by 5 or more, they also take an extra 1d6 force damage.
rules.drawback: The shield used for this ability has a -2 penalty to AC while active.

abilities.warioNote: Hey, it’s just a shield bash! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Fortified Shield
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to half your level when you use a bonus action to bash an enemy with your shield.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable early combat edge at low levels, making it cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters benefit from early combat bonuses that can turn the tide of battle.

rules.effect: Gain 1d10 temporary hit points. This ends if you are incapacitated or you take a long rest.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get hit points and don't have to drop the shield! What could be better?

abilities.name: Riposte Slash
abilities.description: On your turn, when a creature damages you with melee attack, you can make a melee attack against it before your other attacks.
abilities.apReason: It adds an immediate counterattack at the cost of a reaction.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters often need to defend themselves while still taking action.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against the attacking creature. If you hit, it takes an extra 1d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this reaction if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you can turn a bad day into a great comeback! Who needs armor when you've got riposte?

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier when you take the Dodge action.
abilities.apReason: A bonus action with a defensive effect is a reliable edge at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: A new Paladin unlocks at level 1, this gives them early defensive options.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier as temporary hit points. These last until you take the Dodge action again or are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you have temporary hit points.

abilities.warioNote: Wear it like a badge of honor! Or a shield, whichever fits better!

abilities.name: Shady Passage
abilities.description: Gain advantage on stealth checks by blending into shadows for a moment.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that enhances a key Rogue skill at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues benefit from subtle advantages early in the game.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of your next turn. The effect ends if you move more than 5 feet or take an action.
rules.drawback: While using this ability, you can't speak or cast verbal spells.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a peek into the shadows... for an extra coin!

abilities.name: Rage Roar
abilities.description: Shout a primal challenge that intimidates enemies, forcing them to make saves or be slowed.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable combat advantage at a reasonable cost for level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can unleash raw power from their first moments of rage.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you end it
rules.effect: Each creature within range must succeed on a DC 8 + your proficiency + Charisma modifier Wisdom saving throw or become slowed (Movement speed halved) for the duration. This effect ends if you use this ability again.
rules.drawback: You can only shout once per short rest, and enemies might not react the same way to every roar.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting your own mini-boss to slow down the bad guys... for just one AP!

abilities.name: Arcane Insight
abilities.description: Spot hidden traps or secret doors within a 30-foot radius as if you had proficiency.
abilities.apReason: A reliable utility ability that unlocks early for quick exploration advantages.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards often need to find and disarm traps with ease.

rules.effect: You can make an Intelligence (Investigation) check without proficiency when trying to locate a hidden trap or secret door.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 minute concentrating on the area.

abilities.warioNote: Hey, it's not like you're getting a free peek at all the secrets... You still gotta focus!

abilities.name: Raging Shieldbash
abilities.description: Bash an enemy with your shield, dealing damage and stunning them for one turn.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge in close combat, costing only one Ability Point.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters are trained in basic combat tactics early on.

rules.duration: instantaneous, until start of next turn
rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack with your shield. On hit, the target is stunned for one turn (DC 10 + proficiency + Strength modifier). The effect ends if you are disarmed.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For a paltry AP, you get to knock 'em out cold! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Quick Reload
abilities.description: Draw and reload a firearm as a bonus action, ignoring the normal attack penalty.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for continued combat engagement at no cost to action economy but with a resource cost in the form of a full reload.
abilities.levelReason: At level 1, the Gunslinger can already make an attack each round. This ability allows them to stay in combat longer by quickly reloading their weapon.

rules.effect: Drawing and reloading a firearm as a bonus action. Must have an unloaded firearm in hand. The effect ends when the next long rest is completed.
rules.drawback: The firearm must be fully reloaded, meaning you cannot make a ranged attack this round.

abilities.warioNote: For just a few coins, you can keep your enemies guessing! Reload faster than they can blink!

abilities.name: Deadly Shadow
abilities.description: Emerge as a deadly shadow, gaining advantage on attack rolls and causing extra damage.
abilities.apReason: It's a quick edge in close combat and stealth situations without overbalancing the class at level one.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to strike from the shadows early in their careers.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. On a hit, deal an additional 1d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You leave a visible shadow that can be used to track you.

abilities.warioNote: Hey, it’s just a little peek into the dark... for an AP!

abilities.name: Commanding Roar
abilities.description: Roar to inspire allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on the next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that provides a significant tactical advantage, making it worth 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders at level 1 are just starting to learn how to command and inspire their allies effectively.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on the next attack roll. This effect ends when they make that attack.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak clearly and are limited to one use per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah... because sometimes all you need is a good roar to turn the tide of battle. Or maybe it's just my booming voice.

abilities.name: Pond's Insight
abilities.description: Spot hidden items or clues within 30 feet as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a cheap AP cost, fitting the Commoner's role.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can observe and notice things without specialized training.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier; ends when you move more than 15 feet away from the target.
rules.drawback: You can't use this ability if you're blinded or have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

abilities.warioNote: It’s just a tiny peek into the world of observation! For a single AP? You got it!

abilities.name: Fortify Strike
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to your next attack roll. On a hit, you can reduce an enemy's AC by 2 until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat maneuver that provides a small but valuable edge in close combat, unlocking at level 1 to give new militiamen a chance to improve their attacks.
abilities.levelReason: Basic combat training allows for quick reflexes and strategic strikes.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, the target's AC is reduced by 2 until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you miss or make another melee weapon attack on your next turn.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just a little tap, but hey, it can save your life! Only one per day though...

abilities.name: Tool Mastery
abilities.description: Increase tool proficiency checks by +2 and gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that can save the player in a pinch, unlocking at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often need to solve immediate problems with their tools.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until end of next short rest
rules.effect: Proficiency bonus +2 on tool use checks; gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used more than once per day.

abilities.warioNote: Ah, Tool Mastery? It's like getting a free toolbelt and hit points! Who could resist?

abilities.name: Divine Vow
abilities.description: Once per short rest, Paladins can cast a divine spell of 1st level or lower without expending a spell slot.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows casting of basic divine spells without expending slots, offering a modest utility at this cost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins are expected to know basic spells early in their career.

rules.effect: Paladin casts a spell of 1st level or lower, as if using a spell slot. The spell must be from the Paladin's spell list.
rules.drawback: The Paladin cannot cast spells with a higher level than their character level.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just one spell... but it’s free! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Shadowstep
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows, moving unseen for a few steps at the start of your turn.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for early levels, allowing quick escapes and surprise attacks.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain mobility and tactical advantages early in their careers.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You become invisible until the start of your next turn. A creature you can see within 5 feet of you that ends its turn there must succeed on a DC 8 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: While invisible, you have disadvantage on attack rolls.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out, it's like disappearing into thin air! Just don't expect to hit anything while you're gone...

abilities.name: Feral Roar
abilities.description: Roar to frighten enemies within 30 feet, granting advantage on saving throws against fear until the start of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: A combat-oriented ability that provides immediate advantage and fear, justifying 1 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can immediately assert dominance in combat with a roar.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All creatures within range must succeed on a DC 8 + Proficiency + Charisma modifier Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Feral Roar again until after completing a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like selling you the roar of a thousand wildcats—because one cat’s roar is just not enough!

abilities.name: Arcane Echo
abilities.description: Create an illusory duplicate that can cast basic spells, distracting foes or aiding you.
abilities.apReason: An at-will ability that provides immediate tactical flexibility at low cost.
abilities.levelReason: Wizard apprentices can create simple illusions to aid them in combat early on.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.uses: At will with a short rest
rules.effect: Create an illusory duplicate that can cast one spell of 1st level or lower. It has half your hit points and uses your proficiency bonus for attack rolls. If reduced to 0 HP, the echo dissipates.
rules.drawback: The echo is only a distraction and cannot engage in combat directly.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a little wizard buddy to help you out—just don't expect it to fight for you!

abilities.name: Rising Shield
abilities.description: Raise your shield in a single turn to absorb up to half of the next incoming damage.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a reliable edge in combat at this tier.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters at level 1 are learning to defend themselves effectively.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Constitution modifier; reduce up to half of the next damage taken by 50% until end of your next turn; DC is failed on a save.
rules.drawback: Only works once per combat.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a shield that grows when you need it most! Or, ya know, when it’s too late...

abilities.name: Deceptive Reload
abilities.description: Quickly reload a firearm without exposing your position to ranged attacks.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge, and this one allows quick rearmament without sacrificing attack speed.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers benefit from quick rearmament early in their career.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to your next Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check made before the end of your next short rest.
rules.drawback: The reload is silent but you must be in light or no armor.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, just one AP for that fancy reload? What’s next, free ammo?

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.description: Becomes nearly invisible for a round, advantaging Stealth checks made during that time.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for early levels that can be used frequently without exhausting resources.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to move unseen at the beginning of their training.

rules.effect: While active, all Stealth checks made are at advantage. Ends when a combat action is taken or the duration expires.
rules.drawback: Cannot move more than 5 feet while this ability is active.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just a little shadowmeld... but it'll make ya disappear!

abilities.name: Inspire Resolve
abilities.description: You inspire allies within 30 feet, granting them advantage on saving throws and attack rolls until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: A reliable support ability that aids the party with a bonus action, unlocking it early in the Leader's career.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership is key at level 1 to bolster new groups and establish camaraderie.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on saving throws and attack rolls. This effect ends when you use another Inspire Resolve.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see at least one ally for this ability to function.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single Ability Point? You get an instant morale boost! What’s not to like?

abilities.name: Street Smarts
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Charisma checks made to influence others or provide information.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities are small reliable edges; gaining advantage on important checks fits here well.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often have a knack for navigating social situations effectively.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: When you make an Charisma check to influence others or provide information, you gain advantage on that roll.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 hour in a social setting each day to maintain this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, Street Smarts. Just what the doctor ordered when you're trying to hustle a few coins from a suspicious merchant.

abilities.name: Rallying Cry
abilities.description: Shout to bolster allies, granting temporary hit points and advantage on attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable boost to allied combat effectiveness, unlocking early in training.
abilities.levelReason: Militia members gain confidence from group cohesion early in training.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain 1d6 temporary hit points and advantage on attack rolls. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be at least one level higher for each additional ally affected.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! It's just a little shout... but it’ll make your friends feel like they can take on the world!

abilities.name: Toolchain Boost
abilities.description: Quickly repair or improvise a tool, granting a temporary proficiency bonus.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for improvisation and repair work, unlocking at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often need to fix tools on the fly without losing their edge in combat.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to one tool-related check or attack with an improvised weapon. This ends when you make another tool-related check.
rules.drawback: While using Toolchain Boost, your proficiency in the chosen skill is halved.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! This little boost might seem cheap, but when you're out of tools, it's priceless!

abilities.name: Holy Aura
abilities.description: Your holy aura grants allies within 10 feet advantage on saving throws against fear effects.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a reliable support effect at level 1 without overwhelming its purpose as divine support.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can provide immediate support from their first moments of training.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on saving throws against fear effects. Ends when you are incapacitated or fall unconscious.
rules.drawback: You must be conscious to maintain the aura; otherwise, it fades.

abilities.warioNote: Need some extra courage? Just $1 in Ability Points! Your friends will thank you!

abilities.name: Shadow Evasion
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws and hide checks while moving up to your speed.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities grant small reliable edges for Rogues.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues benefit from stealth and survival at level 1.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: When you use this ability, you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws and hide checks while moving up to your speed. This ends when a creature successfully hits you with an attack.
rules.drawback: While using this ability, you can't take reactions or bonus actions.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just a little peek into the shadows... for an AP!

abilities.name: Rampage Roar
abilities.description: Shake off fatigue and unleash a primal roar to bolster allies within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: It provides a reliable edge in combat at this early level, but requires your attention to activate.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can harness their rage early to rally nearby allies.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Allies within 30 feet gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. Save DC 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Rumble up the morale of your crew with this one! It's like giving them a power-up pill!

abilities.name: Arcane Lockpick
abilities.description: Unlock or disable locks by focusing your arcane knowledge.
abilities.apReason: A reliable utility ability that can be used frequently without draining resources.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards often need to access restricted areas early in their training.

rules.effect: You make a Dexterity (Stealth) check contested by the lock's DC. On success, you unlock or disable it.
rules.drawback: The spell has a 10% chance to break if used on an enchanted lock.

abilities.warioNote: These locks are so easy, even Wario could pick 'em with his bare hands!

abilities.name: Rageborn Might
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your fighter level when you enter a rage.
abilities.apReason: Gaining temporary hit points at will is a reliable combat edge early in play.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking this ability at level 1 allows for early combat survivability in fights.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain 1d10 temporary hit points when you enter a rage. This effect ends if you leave rage prematurely.
rules.drawback: If reduced to 0 or fewer hit points while raging, you lose all temporary hit points and cannot regain any until the end of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to rage and live longer! What could be better?

abilities.name: Flashfire Volley
abilities.description: Fire a rapid volley of shots, stunning any enemy hit.
abilities.apReason: It provides a significant combat edge at level 1 without being overpowered.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers need to establish their offensive capabilities early.

rules.effect: Make a ranged weapon attack. If the target is hit, it must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, you think it’s just for show? This here’s what happens when your opponent gets hit by a volley of bullets! *priceless*

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Quickly reposition yourself to a space of your choice within 5 feet.
abilities.apReason: A quick movement ability that provides an immediate tactical advantage but comes with a visual risk.
abilities.levelReason: Spies must be able to move unseen and swiftly to gather information or evade danger.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within range. You must be able to see a target point in the space you end up in.
rules.drawback: You leave a faint shadow for 1 minute, allowing creatures of your choice within 10 feet to make a DC 8 + Dexterity modifier Wisdom saving throw or see where you were.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s fast... but not *too* fast! See those little shadows? They’ll give away your next move!

abilities.name: Commanding Gesture
abilities.description: Wave your hand to bolster an ally's defense, granting them a temporary shield bonus.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for leaders, useful in tight situations.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership skills are valuable even at the start of play.

rules.effect: Choose one willing ally within reach. That ally gains a +2 bonus to AC until the start of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once every 8 hours.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single point? Boost your buddy's defenses! Can't get much better than that!

abilities.name: Jury-Rig Fix
abilities.description: Quickly mend a broken weapon or tool, restoring it to working order as if you had the appropriate skills.
abilities.apReason: It's a small but useful ability that provides an immediate benefit without requiring complex interaction.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often find themselves in need of improvised tools and weapons.

rules.effect: You can use a bonus action to fix a broken weapon or tool, restoring it to functional condition. This does not restore lost hit points.
rules.drawback: The item must be within reach and cannot be larger than you.

abilities.warioNote: You think you can't afford tools? Just fix 'em with this! Cheaper than buying new ones, right?

abilities.name: Pound Shield
abilities.description: Bash your shield with a mighty strike, forcing enemies to save or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: This is a reliable edge for a level 1 combatant with basic training.
abilities.levelReason: Basic combat training allows for simple but effective tactics like this.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack with your shield. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 8 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability once every short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey! It’s just a shield bash, but it’ll pack some punch!

abilities.name: Toolforge
abilities.description: Increase tool proficiency checks by 1d6, but you must use a specific set of tools.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that enhances utility abilities at low levels.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often need to quickly assess and improve their tools on the fly.

rules.effect: When you make a tool proficiency check, roll an additional d6. This effect ends if you switch to another set of tools.
rules.drawback: You must specify the exact toolset when activating this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Need a wrench? Get it for free! Who needs actual tools, right?

abilities.name: Blessed Shield Strike
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 holy damage on melee attacks. Once per short rest.
abilities.apReason: This is a combat-focused ability that offers a reliable edge at level 1, fitting the Paladin's role as an armored protector and fighter.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain this ability early to bolster their defensive prowess and offensive capabilities.

rules.effect: On a melee attack, you deal an extra 1d6 holy damage. This effect ends on your next short or long rest.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are not wielding a shield.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like getting your shield to do extra damage for you... if you’re not screwing up with it.

abilities.name: Shadow Thief
abilities.description: Stealthily move and strike, gaining advantage on attack rolls while within a shadowy aura.
abilities.apReason: Gives a significant combat edge at low levels without being overpowered.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues start by excelling in both stealth and precision strikes.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Save DC 8 + Dex modifier.
rules.drawback: While active, you move at half speed.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You think this is cheap? Try doing that while dodging guards and traps!

abilities.name: Ravage Roar
abilities.description: Roar to scare enemies, forcing them to make a saving throw or be knocked prone.
abilities.apReason: Provides combat advantage at level 1 with a moderate drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can use their primal instincts early in the game.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Strength modifier; on a failed save, target is knocked prone. Effect ends when the target moves.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if already prone.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like having your own little earthquake! Terrifying, but... noisy!

abilities.name: Arcane Resonance
abilities.description: Cast a minor spell that enhances your next attack with magical energy.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 cost is justified by its immediate combat utility and at-will availability.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at level 1 as it provides a small reliable edge to combat.

rules.effect: When you make your next attack roll, add +2 bonus on the damage. Ends if you cast a spell with a higher level.
rules.drawback: You must finish a short rest before using this ability again.

abilities.warioNote: It’s just a little spark, but it sure packs a punch!

abilities.name: Shield Stabilize
abilities.description: Push back nearby enemies to stabilize a precarious shield wall.
abilities.apReason: It provides immediate combat advantage at first level, making it a reliable edge in close combat.
abilities.levelReason: First-level fighters are skilled in basic combat tactics and can defend their comrades effectively.

rules.effect: When you take the Dodge action, as a reaction when hit by an attack within 5 feet, push all creatures within 10 feet of you up to 10 feet away from you. Save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier.
rules.drawback: You must be wielding a shield and cannot use this reaction again until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Push 'em back, but don't expect to do it twice so fast!

abilities.name: Snap Shot
abilities.description: The gunslinger makes a quick, precise shot with +1d6 damage to a target within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: A combat-focused bonus action that enhances a single attack at no cost, justifying a moderate AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows the gunslinger to quickly apply their precision in combat.

rules.effect: On a hit, add +1d6 damage. This ability ends when you attack again on your turn.
rules.drawback: You must use the Attack action to benefit from this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah right, like you can't already reload faster than everyone else? But I'll let you buy it anyway.

abilities.name: Shadow Veil
abilities.description: Become nearly invisible, granting a +4 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks for one minute.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for a level 1 ability, allowing the spy to blend into any environment quickly and effectively.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to blend into their surroundings unnoticed.

rules.effect: Dexterity (Stealth) check advantage; ends when the effect ends or you willingly end it early.
rules.drawback: You must remain still for 10 feet during this time.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of a few berries, you get to become a ghost in the night!

abilities.name: Inspire Focus
abilities.description: Boost an ally's attack roll by +1d6 when you spend your Action Point.
abilities.apReason: This ability gives the team a small but reliable edge, justifying one Action Point.
abilities.levelReason: A Leader at level 1 can provide a small, reliable edge to the team.

rules.effect: When you spend an Action Point, choose an ally within reach. That target's next attack roll is at advantage and gains a +1d6 modifier.
rules.drawback: You may only use this ability once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single Action Point? You get to boost your friend's attack, what more could you ask?

abilities.name: Toss & Trade
abilities.description: Quickly swap your improvised weapon for a nearby object, gaining a +2 bonus to attack rolls with the new item.
abilities.apReason: A quick adaptation at no cost, but it requires a bonus action to use.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often find themselves in situations where they must adapt quickly.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls with the new item. The item reverts back after one round.
rules.drawback: The improvised weapon or object must be within reach and not too large for you.

abilities.warioNote: Need that tin can to look like a mace? Toss & Trade! Only 1 AP, but you might end up with a rusty old pot.

abilities.name: Fortified Guard
abilities.description: Gain advantage on your next saving throw against an attack after receiving damage this round.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a basic Militia, providing defensive advantage after taking hits.
abilities.levelReason: Militias often receive basic training in defensive maneuvers early in their careers.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on one saving throw against an attack made before the start of your next turn after taking damage this round. The effect ends if you take any damage during that time.
rules.drawback: You must have taken damage in the same round to activate.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Fortify yourself with this one! Just remember—no use without some damage first!

abilities.name: Jury-Rig Shield
abilities.description: Quickly repair a broken shield, gaining +2 AC until your next long rest.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that can change one encounter beat at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often need to quickly fix their gear in the field.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC until you finish a long rest. This effect ends if the shield is destroyed.
rules.drawback: The repair only holds for as long as you're not hit in combat.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a shield... until it’s not. Oh, the irony!

abilities.name: Divine Vigil
abilities.description: Gain advantage on saving throws until you take a short rest.
abilities.apReason: Gaining advantage and an additional use per long rest justify the cost at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain divine inspiration early, so this ability taps into that resource.

rules.duration: until the start of your next short rest
rules.effect: You can use a bonus action to gain advantage on all saving throws until you take a short rest. This effect ends when you complete a short rest.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a little prayer... but it’ll keep your butt from frying!

abilities.name: Shady Exchange
abilities.description: Swap a hand weapon for a light crossbow, gaining its range without provoking opportunity attacks.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for quick adaptation in combat at no cost, making it versatile and useful from the start.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows Rogues to quickly adapt in combat situations.

rules.effect: You can swap a hand weapon for a light crossbow as a reaction. You gain the range of the light crossbow but are still considered to be holding your original weapon.
rules.drawback: After using this ability, you cannot use it again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need to ditch that pesky sword? Shady Exchange's got you covered—just a dime!

abilities.name: Raging Bash
abilities.description: Smash an opponent with a shield for extra damage and stun.
abilities.apReason: A single-use reaction that offers significant combat impact at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians start combat strong and this lets them hit hard early on.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, the target is stunned until its next action. If you miss, you take 2d6 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: You can only use this ability when raging.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, you think it's just a shield bash... until your enemy hits the ground with a thud!

abilities.name: Arcane Snapshot
abilities.description: Quickly cast a minor spell for an immediate effect.
abilities.apReason: Provides a versatile utility at level 1 for spellcasting versatility without draining resources.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards need quick access to their spells at level 1.

rules.effect: Choose a spell of 1st level or lower; cast it as an attack action that deals no damage but imposes the stunned condition on one target for 1 round. Save DC = 8 + Proficiency + Intelligence modifier.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if concentration is required, and the spell cannot be selected from a prepared list.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s cheap... but you better know your spells!

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: Gain advantage on your next ranged attack roll after you have moved at least 10 feet since your last action.
abilities.apReason: It gives a small edge in combat, unlocking at level 1 as a reliable ability to improve accuracy through movement.
abilities.levelReason: Beginners need to learn how movement can improve their accuracy in combat.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on one ranged attack roll made before your next action. The effect ends if you do not make an attack with that weapon by the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Only usable once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Steady Aim? Yeah... it's like getting a free peek before you shoot. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Flurry Shots
abilities.description: Fire two additional rounds at the start of your turn, dealing an extra d8 damage with each.
abilities.apReason: This combat-focused ability enhances the Gunslinger's firing speed at no cost, making it worth one Ability Point.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers unlock their first combat ability to enhance their firing speed early in their career.

rules.effect: When you start your turn, you can fire two additional rounds. These deal an extra d8 damage each. You must have a loaded firearm to use this ability.
rules.drawback: You cannot reload or perform any other action during the same bonus action.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, sure! For just a single Ability Point, you can pack a little more punch into those bullets. But watch out—no reloading this turn!

abilities.name: Shadow Mirage
abilities.description: Emerge as a shadowy doppelgänger to confuse foes, granting temporary cover.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that provides a reliable edge for the first minute of combat.
abilities.levelReason: Spies at level 1 are learning basic deception techniques.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you. Concentrate on this effect (as a bonus action) or fail a DC 8 + DEX modifier Wisdom saving throw.
rules.drawback: While active, you can't take reactions.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like being a ghost... but not permanently. Sorry, it only lasts a bit!

abilities.name: Voice of Command
abilities.description: Command allies with a single word, granting them advantage on their next attack or saving throw.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge early in play, providing immediate support to allies.
abilities.levelReason: Leader's voice is crucial early in the game to bolster allies quickly.

rules.effect: Allies within earshot gain advantage on their next attack roll or saving throw. Lasts until used.
rules.drawback: Must be on a clear vocal command; whispering or mispronunciation negates the effect.

abilities.warioNote: You think that voice of yours is worth only one AP? Try commanding an army!

abilities.name: Quickfix Armor
abilities.description: Swiftly patch a damaged shield to gain +2 AC until your next short rest.
abilities.apReason: It provides a reliable combat advantage at level 1, justifying the cost of 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often find themselves in urgent need of makeshift defenses.

rules.effect: You gain +2 AC until your next short rest. This effect ends if you take damage.
rules.drawback: The shield must be damaged to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah, sure, it's just a quickfix, but hey, you won't find better patch jobs in Toad Town!

abilities.name: Guardian's Vigil
abilities.description: You can temporarily bolster your allies' defenses, granting them advantage on saving throws for the next minute.
abilities.apReason: This support ability provides ongoing benefit to allies at a cost that fits its utility and duration.
abilities.levelReason: Militia are trained to protect and assist their comrades in immediate danger.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, one willing creature touched makes a saving throw. Until the end of their next turn, they have advantage on all saving throws.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after completing a short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Guard your friends, but don’t overdo it! You can’t keep them safe all the time!

abilities.name: Precision Finish
abilities.description: On your turn, after hitting with an improvised weapon attack, you can reroll missed rolls to hit for the same target.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a reliable combat edge at level 1, justifying its cost.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans need a reliable edge in combat early on.

rules.effect: If you hit with an improvised weapon attack and would normally miss, you can use your reaction to reroll the attack roll. You must take the result of the second roll.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if attacking a creature with more than one hit point.

abilities.warioNote: Trust me, you'll want to finish the job on that tough guy. Precision Finish can save your bacon!

abilities.name: Divine Aegis
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to AC and deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage on melee weapon attacks.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable defensive and offensive edge at level 1, making it cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain combat prowess early, needing this defense boost at level 1.

rules.effect: When you make a melee weapon attack, deal an extra 1d6 radiant damage and gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to look tougher AND hit harder. What's not to like?

abilities.name: Shadow Strike
abilities.description: On a successful hit with a dagger or shortsword, deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage and gain advantage on your next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a level 1 Rogue.
abilities.levelReason: New Rogues can learn to exploit the element of surprise for their first few strikes.

rules.effect: On a successful attack with dagger or shortsword, deal 1d6 necrotic damage and gain advantage on your next attack roll against the same target.
rules.drawback: May only be used once per combat.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to deal extra damage and hit harder. What more could you want?

abilities.name: Fury Slam
abilities.description: Deal an additional 1d8 bludgeoning damage on your first melee attack of the turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability that provides a reliable combat edge at this stage of play.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can unleash their fury at level 1.

rules.duration: until next short or long rest
rules.effect: When you make a melee attack on your first turn of combat, add 1d8 bludgeoning damage to the attack.
rules.drawback: You must finish your next turn without making another melee attack or lose the benefit.

abilities.warioNote: Feel the fury, but remember it’s one slam per bash!

abilities.name: Arcane Pulse
abilities.description: Quickly conjure a burst of arcane energy to damage foes within range.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge, justifying the cost of 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards can cast minor spells at level 1.

rules.effect: You create a pulse of arcane energy centered on yourself. Each creature in the 10-foot radius sphere around you must make a DC 8 + Intelligence modifier + proficiency bonus saving throw or take 2d6 force damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Arcane Pulse if you have used it this short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario, it's like getting a quick zap from a battery-powered toy—fun but not as powerful as some of my other tricks!

abilities.name: Sharpshooter's Aim
abilities.description: Deal extra damage on a hit with ranged weapons within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat edge that impacts every ranged attack at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Aiming for precision is crucial at level 1.

rules.effect: On a hit with a ranged weapon, deal an additional 1d6 damage. Ends when the fighter's next attack misses.
rules.drawback: Must declare the use of this ability before rolling the attack.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s a cheap shot, but hey, you gotta start somewhere. Maybe even hit something!

abilities.name: Quickfix Gear
abilities.description: Repair damaged firearms or armor, rendering them functional for the next battle.
abilities.apReason: This utility ability allows for quick repairs, fitting a Gunslinger's need for reliable gear and unlocking at the level where they can benefit from immediate support.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers often find themselves in tight spots where repairs are needed quickly.

rules.effect: Choose one piece of damaged light armor or firearm you touch. It gains the repaired condition and becomes functional until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1d4 minutes repairing any chosen item if it is not used before that time.

abilities.warioNote: Need your firearms to work? It’s cheaper than buying new ones! Just a quick fix and you’re ready to go.

abilities.name: Shadow Dodge
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws made to avoid attacks.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for a level 1 Spy, granting critical situational advantage on Dexterity saves.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often find themselves in dangerous situations where quick reflexes are critical.

rules.effect: When you take the Attack action, you can roll your Dexterity saving throw and use the lower result. You gain advantage on all such saves.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if already incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, dodge that! But don't expect it to work twice in a day!

abilities.name: Commanding Signal
abilities.description: Shout a signal for your allies to flank an enemy, granting them advantage on attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 1 with a limited use per rest.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders at level 1 can inspire and coordinate their team's initial movements.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range target an enemy. On their next attack roll against that target, they gain advantage.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see and hear all targets for this ability to function.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little signal... but it could save the day!

abilities.name: Rapid Repair
abilities.description: Quickly fix minor damages to armor, restoring 1d6 + Dexterity modifier hit points.
abilities.apReason: This utility ability offers a reliable edge at level 1, allowing quick fixes in combat situations.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often find themselves in tight spots where they need to quickly address their equipment's issues.

rules.effect: Restores 1d6 + Dexterity modifier hit points. This effect ends when the armor is no longer damaged.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used on magical or unrepairable equipment.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need your armor fixed fast? This little trick'll have you back on the field in no time—just one AP, though!

abilities.name: Shield Bearer
abilities.description: Gain +1 bonus on AC and advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone while you are wielding a shield.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that provides immediate combat benefit without requiring action usage.
abilities.levelReason: Militia's primary role is defense, making this ability immediately useful for survival in combat.

rules.effect: AC +1 and advantage on saving throws against prone while wielding a shield; ends when you stop wielding the shield.
rules.drawback: You lose this bonus if your shield is damaged or not being used.

abilities.warioNote: Guarding yourself? Why buy it from me when you can just use any old shield?

abilities.name: Toolcraft Boost
abilities.description: Craft improvised weapons and tools with devastating accuracy, bypassing attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities offer a reliable edge, and this one enhances combat versatility without overreaching.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans at level 1 can start to make basic tools and weapons.

rules.effect: When making a tool-based attack, the Artisan adds their proficiency bonus to the damage roll. The effect ends when they make another attack with an improvised weapon or tool.
rules.drawback: Cannot use this ability if proficient in any martial weapons.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a little tool to help you out... or so I didn't say it was illegal!

abilities.name: Divine Intercession
abilities.description: Call down divine favor to heal a fallen ally up to half their hit points.
abilities.apReason: Provides immediate healing at a bonus action cost, aligning with the class's ability to quickly provide support.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can immediately provide healing through prayer and faith.

rules.effect: You touch a fallen ally within 30 feet. They regain hit points equal to 1d8 + your Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used until the next long rest after an ally falls in combat.

abilities.warioNote: Worth every AP! Watch your allies rise from the brink of death!

abilities.name: Shadowslip
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows for a turn, then reemerge behind your foe.
abilities.apReason: Provides a combat advantage and stealth utility at level 1, making it a reliable edge.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain the ability to manipulate shadows at level 1.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until used in combat
rules.effect: You become invisible and can move up to your movement speed without triggering opportunity attacks. When you attack an enemy, you reappear behind it. This effect ends if you take damage.
rules.drawback: You must make a successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be exposed for the rest of the duration.

abilities.warioNote: It's like teleportation... but with shadows! And it only costs one AP?!

abilities.name: Fury Bash
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage on your first attack of the round.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge at low levels, justifying 1 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians gain this ability early to capitalize on their rage and aggression.

rules.effect: On your first melee attack action, add 1d6 damage to the attack roll. This effect ends if you miss with this attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used after an unexpected round start.

abilities.warioNote: For Wario: 'What do you get when you mix rage and bash? A Fury Bash! But hey, it only costs one of your precious APs!'

abilities.name: Arcane Whirlwind
abilities.description: Cast a spinning vortex of arcane energy that deals force damage to enemies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: It provides a reliable combat ability at level one that deals moderate damage with a save to avoid it.
abilities.levelReason: It provides a reliable way to clear small groups early on.

rules.effect: Create an area of force damage (d6 + Intelligence modifier) affecting all creatures in a 5-foot radius. Save DC 8 + Proficiency + Intelligence modifier or half damage and be pushed out 5 feet.
rules.drawback: Requires concentration for its duration and can only be used once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like throwing a party, but deadly! Just don’t invite too many guests!

abilities.name: Battering Charge
abilities.description: On a full attack, you can dash up to your movement speed and slam your shield into an enemy, dealing damage equal to 1d8 + Strength modifier.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for level 1 that grants a strong combat option at the start of an encounter.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters often use their initial rush to knock opponents down or open them for attacks.

rules.effect: On a successful melee attack, deal 1d8 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage. You must use your action to charge.
rules.drawback: You can only perform this maneuver once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, it's like buying a whole arsenal of surprise hits! Who needs weapons when you've got this?

abilities.name: Reload Ricochet
abilities.description: When reloading, fire a shot at an enemy within 10 feet for additional damage if you hit.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 1 that provides combat utility during reloading.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the gunslinger has enough precision to aim during reloads.

rules.effect: When you use the Reload action, make a ranged weapon attack against a target in range. If you hit, the attack deals an additional 1d6 damage.
rules.drawback: You must have ammunition for your firearm to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah right, like reloading can be this easy. Bet you've never seen a Reload Ricochet like mine!

abilities.name: Deadly Mirage
abilities.description: Create a convincing illusion to distract an opponent, forcing them to make a saving throw or be disoriented.
abilities.apReason: A quick and reliable edge for level 1 Spies to create immediate distractions.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need quick escapes and distractions at level 1.

rules.duration: until the end of the target's next turn
rules.effect: Target must make a DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + Cha modifier Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are disoriented and can't take actions or reactions until their next turn.
rules.drawback: The illusion is convincing but does not deal damage.

abilities.warioNote: Need a distraction? This'll get you out of sticky situations in a flash! Only costs one AP, but it’s worth its weight in gold!

abilities.name: Commanding Look
abilities.description: With a piercing gaze, you command allies to focus and fight more effectively.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that can improve combat effectiveness at low levels without overburdening resources.
abilities.levelReason: At level 1, leaders can start inspiring their allies immediately with simple gestures.

rules.effect: All willing allies within 30 feet gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks and attack rolls. Lasts until the start of your next turn after a short rest.
rules.drawback: You must be able to see all target allies for this ability to function.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of a single AP, you get your entire team hyped. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Jury-Rig Defense
abilities.description: Quickly reinforce your shield to deal an extra 1d6 damage on your next attack.
abilities.apReason: Jury-Rig Defense provides a short-term tactical advantage and is used as a bonus action, just like other similar abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners start with basic tools and can improvise defensive enhancements.

rules.effect: When you use a bonus action to activate this ability, your shield gains +1d6 damage until the start of your next turn. You must make an attack with that shield before it expires.
rules.drawback: You can only jury-rig one weapon or piece of armor at a time.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need to beef up your shield quick? This one’s for ya. Just don’t expect it to last long!

abilities.name: Guardian Stance
abilities.description: Increase your shield's AC by +2 for yourself, but you must use two-handed grip.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 1 for basic defense techniques.
abilities.levelReason: Basic defense techniques are valuable even at low levels.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you attack or take damage
rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC while holding your shield with two hands. This ends if you attack or take damage.
rules.drawback: While in Guardian Stance, you cannot use any other action that requires the use of one hand.

abilities.warioNote: Guardian this shield better, or it’ll bash your wallet!

abilities.name: Toolchain Mastery
abilities.description: Temporarily enhance your tools to deal an extra die of damage.
abilities.apReason: Gives a reliable edge at level 1, enhancing tool proficiency without being overpowered.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows Artisans to immediately bolster their tool proficiency.

rules.effect: When you attack with a tool, it deals an additional d6 damage. This effect ends when you lose consciousness or if you use this ability again.
rules.drawback: You must spend 5 minutes to recharge any enhanced tools after using Toolchain Mastery.

abilities.warioNote: These tools are already sharp enough... but for an extra AP? Who's counting?

abilities.name: Holy Barrier
abilities.description: Create a shimmering wall of light blocking one creature's melee attacks for your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities that provide immediate combat utility cost 1 AP, and Holy Barrier offers a clear tactical advantage against melee attackers.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can afford to use their divine abilities from an early level, providing immediate combat utility.

rules.effect: When you activate this ability as a reaction to a melee attack against you, the attacker must succeed on a DC 8 + Proficiency + Wisdom modifier saving throw or the attack misses. The effect ends if you are hit by another creature's attack before your next turn.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For the price of a single cookie, this ability's holy shield blocks those pesky attacks! But you gotta rest first—don't abuse it!

abilities.name: Stealth Focus
abilities.description: Increase your Stealth checks by +2 until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: A level 1-4 ability, providing a reliable edge in stealth checks at no cost is fitting for 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: At level 1, Rogues are learning to enhance their basic skills in stealthy maneuvers.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: Your Stealth check results are increased by +2. This effect ends when you make an attack roll or use a bonus action.
rules.drawback: You must remain motionless until your next turn to benefit fully from this ability.

abilities.warioNote: This ain't just another day at the office—this is how you make your Stealth checks count!

abilities.name: Raging Roar
abilities.description: Roar to inspire allies within earshot, granting temporary hit points equal to your level + Con modifier.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong support effect at low levels, making it cost one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 provides early support for the team.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you use this ability again
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Con modifier.
rules.drawback: You must be raging to use this ability.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a roar, but it packs a punch! Or maybe it’s the confidence that comes with it. Either way, worth every AP!

abilities.name: Arcane Whisper
abilities.description: Conjure a silent spell to bolster allies within earshot, granting temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: A reliable support ability that provides immediate benefit for a small cost at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Ideal for level 1, providing immediate utility and support.

rules.effect: Choose one ally within range. They gain 1d8 + Intelligence modifier temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: Must concentrate on an ongoing spell to maintain its effect.

abilities.warioNote: Listen carefully, you might just find this one worth whispering about...

abilities.name: Blindside Slash
abilities.description: On your bonus action, make a melee attack against an enemy within reach. If you miss, the target grants you advantage on opportunity attacks until your next turn.
abilities.apReason: A quick combat maneuver that offers immediate tactical flexibility, costing one AP for the occasional use.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters are often called to strike quickly and decisively early in combat.

rules.effect: If you miss the attack, the target grants you advantage on opportunity attacks until your next turn. Ends when you make an attack or take a rest.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 AP to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: For those times you wish your miss was a hit! Just 1 AP, and you’ll be cutting through enemies left and right!

abilities.name: Ricochet Shot
abilities.description: On a hit with a firearm, you fire an additional bullet that strikes up to two other targets.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant combat boost at level 1 with minimal cost.
abilities.levelReason: As a Gunslinger, precise shots are key; this ability allows for unexpected multi-target damage early on.

rules.effect: You can designate up to two other creatures within 20 feet of the target. Make an attack roll for each designated creature; if you hit, they take fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus + DEX modifier.
rules.drawback: If any shot misses, all shots are wasted.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! For just one AP, you get to turn that single shot into three! Ain't no way that's worth it!

abilities.name: Shadow Dive
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows, becoming invisible for a round as long as you remain still.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at this level allows the spy to gain an immediate tactical advantage.
abilities.levelReason: Spies must learn to disappear in the right moment.

rules.effect: You gain invisibility for 1 round. You make no noise and can't be targeted by area effects, but you must remain perfectly still.
rules.drawback: You become visible if hit or move more than 5 feet.

abilities.warioNote: Hey, it's not every day you can hide in plain sight! But don't go overboard—too much of a good thing could get you caught!

abilities.name: Inspire Vigor
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier when an ally hits you in combat.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable support ability at low levels, costing one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Provides early support and encouragement to allies at low levels.

rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier when an ally hits you in combat. The effect ends if the encounter ends without any allies hitting you.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if no allies are within reach.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single AP, make your friends stronger right when they need it! What more could you ask for?

abilities.name: Improvised Defense
abilities.description: Create a shield from materials at hand, granting +2 to AC for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: Improvising defense is a useful but limited ability, fitting for level 1 Commoners.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can quickly make use of available items in emergencies.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. Concentration is required.
rules.drawback: The improvised shield requires 1 minute to create and can only be used once per day.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, make yourself a shield out of thin air? You’re lucky I’m selling this training at all!

abilities.name: Shield Slam
abilities.description: Push an enemy back and deal force damage equal to your Strength modifier + Constitution modifier.
abilities.apReason: It provides a simple combat option at a low cost, benefiting from the Militia's primary stats and role.
abilities.levelReason: Basic combat training allows for a simple yet effective defensive maneuver.

rules.effect: On a successful hit, the target is pushed back and takes 1d6 + Str Mod + Con Mod force damage. The effect ends if you lose your concentration.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Shield Slam while using a shield that requires two hands.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! You think this little move’s nothin'? Try dodging this Shield Slam!

abilities.name: Tool Synergy
abilities.description: While wielding artisan tools, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat edge that unlocks at level 1, making it cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Basic tool proficiency provides immediate combat utility.

rules.effect: When using artisan tools in a melee attack, you gain a +1 bonus to the roll and your damage. This ends if you stop wielding the tools.
rules.drawback: You lose this bonus when not holding any artisan tools.

abilities.warioNote: You think just handling a hammer makes you better? Oh please!

abilities.name: Divine Focus
abilities.description: Gain advantage on all Wisdom saving throws until you take a short or long rest.
abilities.apReason: It provides a consistent benefit that can turn the tide of battle at lower levels.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins often need to maintain their divine focus in battle.

rules.duration: until you take a short or long rest
rules.effect: You have advantage on all Wisdom saving throws. This ends when you take a short or long rest.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if your concentration is broken.

abilities.warioNote: Oh, this one's a real doozy! Get an edge in your saving throws without spending too many AP. Just don't expect it to last forever!

abilities.name: Shroud Step
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows for a round, gaining advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.apReason: Gives advantage on a key skill at will, providing a reliable edge for early-level Rogues.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain the ability to move without being seen as they gain experience.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks until the start of your next turn. This effect ends if you move more than 10 feet or are seen by an opponent.
rules.drawback: You must remain still during this time; moving even a foot negates its benefit.

abilities.warioNote: Ah, Shroud Step! It’s like wrapping yourself in darkness. Just don’t expect to move much!

abilities.name: Raging Counter
abilities.description: On a successful melee attack, gain temporary hit points equal to your Strength modifier.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that enhances combat effectiveness without overpowered abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians rely on strength and immediate combat opportunities.

rules.effect: When you hit with a melee attack, gain 1d4 + Strength modifier temporary hit points.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if already at maximum hit points.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a little extra health just when you need it! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Arcane Flash
abilities.description: You unleash a burst of arcane energy that blinds enemies within range, forcing them to make saving throws.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 spell with impactful effects and limited range.
abilities.levelReason: A level 1 wizard can cast simple, impactful spells.

rules.effect: Each creature in a 10-foot radius must make a DC 8 + Intelligence modifier + proficiency check or be blinded until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: You can't use this ability if you are blinded.

abilities.warioNote: What do you know? Not every trick needs to be subtle. Sometimes a big flash is just what the doctor ordered!

abilities.name: Shield Barrage
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage with your shield on each melee attack action.
abilities.apReason: Provides a small reliable edge at level 1, enhancing the fighter's defensive capabilities right away.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain weapon expertise early and Shield Barrage boosts their effectiveness immediately.

rules.effect: On each melee attack action, deal an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage with your shield. Ends when you stop making melee attacks.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Shield Barrage if you are not wielding a shield.

abilities.warioNote: For a few Ability Points, you get to bash harder with your shield! What more could you ask for?

abilities.name: Bullet Swift
abilities.description: Increase your reload speed, allowing you to fire an additional round as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: Activating as a bonus action with a drawback justifies its level and cost.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the Gunslinger is learning to handle firearms with precision and speed.

rules.effect: You can make an additional firearm attack as a bonus action. If you hit, the DC for any subsequent Intimidation check against your target is reduced by 2 until the end of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must spend an Action Point to activate this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Bullet Swift? More like Bullet Wrist. But hey, it’s faster than waiting for the reload!

abilities.name: Commanding Shout
abilities.description: Shout orders that boost allies within earshot, granting them advantage on their next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: At level 1, a reliable edge in combat is valuable but not overly powerful.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders start by inspiring immediate tactical advantages for nearby allies.

rules.effect: All friends within 30 feet of you gain advantage on their next attack roll. This effect ends when they make that attack.
rules.drawback: You must be able to speak and see the targets for this ability to function.

abilities.warioNote: Listen up! For just one AP, you get a bonus action that can turn the tide of battle—what's not to like?

abilities.name: Improvised Fort
abilities.description: Quickly reinforce a shield or improvised weapon with vines, granting +2 AC until your next long rest.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat edge at level 1, providing temporary AC enhancement without being overpowered.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often improvise to defend themselves in dangerous situations.

rules.duration: until end of your next long rest
rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next long rest. This effect ends if you lose consciousness.
rules.drawback: You must spend 1 hour between uses to gather materials and prepare.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, it's just a bunch of vines. But hey, it works in a pinch!

abilities.name: Mace Smash
abilities.description: Smash an opponent’s shield, dealing bludgeoning damage and forcing them to make a Strength saving throw or drop their shield.
abilities.apReason: This ability requires a bonus action and provides a combat advantage, justifying its cost of 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: A Militia can now effectively disarm opponents at level 1, giving them a combat advantage.

rules.effect: Make a melee weapon attack against an opponent's shield. On a hit, the target must make a DC 10 + proficiency modifier + Strength modifier Constitution saving throw or drop their shield.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if both hands are occupied.

abilities.warioNote: Mace Smash? More like 'Mace Mash' to get that shield off! But hey, it’s only one AP... right?

abilities.name: Masterful Finishing Touch
abilities.description: Quickly repair or finish a task, granting a bonus to an ability check.
abilities.apReason: It provides a significant but temporary boost at low cost.
abilities.levelReason: At level 1, Artisans can quickly complete small tasks efficiently.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, choose one tool check. You gain a +2 bonus to the roll for up to 1 hour.
rules.drawback: You may only use this ability once per long rest.

abilities.warioNote: This ain't no magic wand, but it sure makes those repairs faster!

abilities.name: Divine Judgment
abilities.description: Call down divine wrath to smite your foe with a single, powerful attack.
abilities.apReason: A combat ability that provides immediate offensive power without requiring resources beyond the bonus action.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking early to give Paladins a strong combat tool from the start.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 + Charisma modifier radiant damage and is knocked prone.
rules.drawback: The target can use an action to attempt a DC 8 + Wisdom modifier saving throw to resist.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a little god on your shoulder, just waiting for you to say 'smite'.

abilities.name: Shroud Stepper
abilities.description: You can briefly merge with shadows, moving through dim light as if it were your own.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant stealth bonus at level 1, justifying 1 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain bonuses to Dexterity-based checks and have access to stealthy maneuvers at level 1.

rules.uses: once per short or long rest
rules.effect: You can move through dim light as if it were dark, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This ends when your concentration is broken.
rules.drawback: Concentrating on this ability prevents you from taking reactions.

abilities.warioNote: Don't think it's easy to sneak past me! For only 1 AP, this one can make you blend into the shadows like a pro!

abilities.name: Ravage Charge
abilities.description: On your move, you can charge and make a melee attack. On a hit, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge in combat for new characters, and this one improves your attacks on the move.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at level 1 to give new Barbarians immediate combat options.

rules.effect: On a hit with a melee attack, the target takes an extra 1d6 damage. Ends when you make the attack.
rules.drawback: You must move at least 10 feet to activate.

abilities.warioNote: This ability’s got you running like a bull. Just don’t forget to charge!

abilities.name: Arcane Brew
abilities.description: Concoct a potent philter that grants you advantage on one d20 roll of your choice before it is made.
abilities.apReason: Creating a potent but single-use advantage at-will costs a modest amount of training.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards are adept at brewing small, effective concoctions early in their studies.

rules.effect: You may activate this ability to create a philter that grants you advantage on one d20 roll of your choice before it is made. The effect ends once the roll is made.
rules.drawback: The philter can only be created for one specific roll, and its effects do not stack.

abilities.warioNote: Taste this potion, but remember, you get only one chance to impress!

abilities.name: Rapid Parry
abilities.description: Gain advantage on a weapon attack when you are hit by an enemy's melee attack.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability providing immediate combat utility and a reaction, costing 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at level 1 as it provides immediate combat utility.

rules.effect: When you are hit by a melee attack, immediately make a weapon attack against the attacker as part of this reaction. The DC for your saving throw is 8 + your proficiency bonus.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Rapid Parry if you have already taken the Attack action on that turn.
