abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, this one’s a doozy! It’s like getting a free shot back when you’re already hit. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Bullet Ballet
abilities.description: Perform a dazzling series of shots, scoring on all targets within range.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that grants a combat advantage at the cost of an action point.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows the Gunslinger to showcase their precision early.

rules.effect: You make a ranged weapon attack against each creature in a 15-foot cone within range. Each hit deals 1d6 + DEX modifier fire damage.
rules.drawback: After using Bullet Ballet, you are targets of opportunity for one minute.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, it’s fancy… but can’t hurt or help anyone else. Just a pretty distraction!

abilities.name: Silent Reveal
abilities.description: Spot hidden creatures within 30 feet as if you had advantage on Perception checks.
abilities.apReason: This is a small reliable edge at level 1, allowing the spy to quickly gather crucial information.
abilities.levelReason: Spies at level 1 need to quickly assess their environment for threats.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until a short rest
rules.effect: You can make Perception checks without disadvantage due to hidden creatures. Ends when you finish a short rest.
rules.drawback: You must declare the use of this ability before making any Perception check for the duration.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a superpower to see through shadows—just don't overuse it or you'll give away your position!

abilities.name: Signal of Unity
abilities.description: Lead your allies in a coordinated charge, granting them advantage on attack rolls for the next round.
abilities.apReason: Provides a meaningful tactical boost at level 1 without being overly powerful
abilities.levelReason: Leaders inspire their allies from an early age; this ability reflects that.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: Each ally within 30 feet has advantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a wave of your hand... but it makes 'em fight better! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Improvised Shield
abilities.description: For a minor adjustment, your shield becomes a versatile weapon that grants you +1d6 to attack rolls with improvised weapons.
abilities.apReason: Provides a minor combat advantage at level 1, making it cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often improvise and need basic combat flexibility early on.

rules.effect: When you take the Attack action, you can substitute your shield for an improvised weapon. You gain +1d6 to attack and damage rolls with that weapon.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if your shield is damaged or missing.

abilities.warioNote: This shield's versatility? It’s just a regular one with a little spit and shine. Cheap as dirt!

abilities.name: Guardian Shield
abilities.description: Redirect a melee attack to a nearby ally, reducing your damage taken by half.
abilities.apReason: A basic defensive maneuver that provides a reliable edge in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Basic training teaches the fundamentals of defensive combat.

rules.effect: When attacked, you can use your reaction to redirect half the damage to an adjacent ally. The attack misses you and hits them instead.
rules.drawback: You take at least 1/4 of the redirected damage.

abilities.warioNote: Guardian Shield? You got it! It’s like having a shield that protects your friends too!

abilities.name: Tool Precision
abilities.description: Increase tool proficiency checks by +2d6, but suffer a -1 penalty on Dexterity saving throws until next short rest.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 1, this ability helps Artisans perfect their craft quickly.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans start their career with basic tools and need to perfect precision early.

rules.duration: 1 minute, ends if you take a long rest or are incapacitated
rules.effect: You gain a +2d6 bonus to all Dexterity (Tools) checks. You also suffer a -1 penalty on Dexterity saving throws until after your next short rest.
rules.drawback: Temporary -1 penalty on Dexterity saving throws.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, Tool Precision will make your tools sing, but don't go thinking it's for free!

abilities.name: Sacred Shield
abilities.description: Gain a +1 bonus to AC as long as you are not attacking or moving at more than half speed.
abilities.apReason: Provides an ongoing combat benefit without requiring specific actions, making it cost-effective for a level 1 ability.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain bonuses early to enhance their frontline presence and survivability.

rules.duration: until you attack or move at more than half speed
rules.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while not attacking or moving at more than half speed.
rules.drawback: Your AC cannot exceed 20.

abilities.warioNote: For just 1 AP, you get to look like you're wearing plate armor! Who needs real gear?

abilities.name: Shadowstep Evasion
abilities.description: While hidden, you can move up to your movement speed without triggering opportunity attacks.
abilities.apReason: A reliable stealth-focused ability like Shadowstep Evasion should cost 1 AP at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: A Rogue's first ability should give them a reliable edge in stealth and mobility.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you move out of an area where you are hidden
rules.effect: While hidden, you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can use your movement without provoking opportunity attacks. Ends when you stop being hidden.
rules.drawback: If observed or detected while using this ability, the duration is reduced to zero.

abilities.warioNote: It's not about the size of your shoes... it's all in the shadow!

abilities.name: Bloodied Fury
abilities.description: On your turn after taking damage, deal an extra 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage to a creature within reach.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability providing reliable combat edge at the cost of resource management.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 provides early combat prowess and reliable edge in close combat.

rules.activation: on your turn after taking damage
rules.effect: deal 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage to a creature within reach. Save DC is equal to 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are not bloodied.

abilities.warioNote: You think it's just damage? No, it's extra fury in every blow! And it costs only one AP! What more could you ask for?

abilities.name: Shattering Bash
abilities.description: Deal extra force damage on your bash attack, dealing double damage to creatures reduced to half hit points.
abilities.apReason: A versatile ability that enhances bash attacks at no cost, providing both an immediate and powerful advantage for a single AP.
abilities.levelReason: Bash attacks are an important part of a Fighter's arsenal at level 1.

rules.effect: When you make a bash attack, it deals extra force damage equal to your strength modifier. If the target is reduced to half its hit points or fewer, this damage is doubled.
rules.drawback: You must declare you are using Shattering Bash before making the attack roll.

abilities.warioNote: Need to take out that last hit point? This’ll do it! One AP, no muss, no fuss!

abilities.name: Shooting Star
abilities.description: The gunslinger channels starlight to enhance their shots, dealing an extra d6 damage.
abilities.apReason: Level 1-4 abilities provide small reliable edges in combat and Shooting Star fits that tier.
abilities.levelReason: Enhances combat effectiveness early in the Gunslinger's career.

rules.effect: When you make a firearm attack, add 1d6 damage. This effect ends when you make another firearm attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if the gunslinger is wearing heavy armor.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's fancy as heck, but you can't use it if you're wearing those big metal suits. So think twice!

abilities.name: Shadowmeld Step
abilities.description: Merge with shadows to move silently and avoid detection for a short time.
abilities.apReason: A minor but critical edge for early level Spies to get into position unseen.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to move unseen in the first moments of an operation.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you move more than 30 feet
rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This ends when you take a hostile action.
rules.drawback: While active, you can't cast spells that require verbal components.

abilities.warioNote: See something? Hide it! For just a few coins!

abilities.name: Commanding Call
abilities.description: Shout to rally allies within earshot, granting them advantage on next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: An ability that provides a situational bonus action for leadership at level 1 should cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders inspire from an early age; this ability reflects that role at level 1.

rules.duration: until the end of next turn
rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on their first attack roll before this ends. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be visible and heard by your allies.

abilities.warioNote: Listen, you need to scream it loud enough for them to hear? It’s just a buck!

abilities.name: Craft Insight
abilities.description: On a successful tool check, you gain advantage on one attack roll or saving throw made before the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge at low levels, fitting for level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often need to make critical checks in tight situations.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain advantage on one attack roll or saving throw. This effect ends when you make the roll.
rules.drawback: You must use this ability within 1 minute of completing a successful tool check.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a little trick with your tools... but watch the price tag!

abilities.name: Radiant Shield
abilities.description: Create a shimmering barrier that reduces incoming damage by half for yourself or an ally.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge in combat at level 1, enhancing defense without overpowered effects.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins begin to channel divine energy early in their training.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until the wearer takes damage
rules.effect: The target gains a +2 bonus to AC and reduces incoming damage by half. Ends when the target takes damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used on yourself once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For a measly AP? You get a shield that actually works! What more could you want?

abilities.name: Shroud Strike
abilities.description: You merge into shadows, delivering a precise attack from an unseen vantage point.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities should have minimal AP cost to encourage early-game utility.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain precision and stealth at level 1 to aid their combat roles.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures you don't provoke an attack from. On a hit, they must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be restrained until the end of their next turn.
rules.drawback: While shrouded, you cannot use any action other than an attack.

abilities.warioNote: It's not just a step... it's a stealthy one! Watch out, your enemies won't even see you coming!

abilities.name: Bloodied Strike
abilities.description: On your last hit point, deal an extra 1d6 damage with your next melee attack.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that can tip the balance in a close fight at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians channel primal fury into their attacks early in training.

rules.effect: On hit with a melee attack while at maximum hit points, deal an additional 1d6 damage. Ends when you drop to 0 hit points.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if already dealing extra damage.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting an extra punch in when you're already bleeding... or something. Doesn't cost much, but it packs quite a punch!

abilities.name: Arcane Sketch
abilities.description: Quicklyscribbleaconceptontoconjurnewmagicsfromit.
abilities.apReason: Generates anewmagicalconceptatminimalcost.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards often experiment with new spells from their studies.

rules.effect: Createa3rd-levelspellwithan8+INTmodDCsave.Toend,casttheoriginalspell.
rules.drawback: Theconjuredspellcannotmatchanyfromyourspellbook.

abilities.warioNote: Sketching'snotfighting,butit'sfree!Whoop!

abilities.name: Raging Shield Bash
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 bludgeoning damage with a shield bash, once per short rest.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide small reliable edges that justify 1 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to use their shields more effectively as they advance in combat.

rules.effect: When you make a melee weapon attack with your shield, add 1d6 bludgeoning damage to the attack.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if the fighter is not wielding a shield.

abilities.warioNote: For those who think shields are just for blocking, this one's for you! Slam them hard!

abilities.name: Rapid Aim
abilities.description: The Gunslinger draws a weapon or reloads a firearm as part of the same action.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities should have a small, reliable edge to start, and this allows for efficient weapon handling at no cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows for efficient use of firearms from early on.

rules.effect: The Gunslinger can draw a weapon or reload a firearm as part of the same action. This replaces their normal attack action.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used with other actions that have an attack component.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, save time reloading. But hey, you can’t do everything fast!

abilities.name: Shade Escape
abilities.description: Disappear into a shadowy mist, becoming unseen and moving through difficult terrain at half speed.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability that provides a significant tactical advantage at low cost.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to escape without being noticed.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You become invisible until the start of your next turn. You can move through difficult terrain as if it were normal terrain, but at half speed.
rules.drawback: If you take any damage or a creature uses an action to target you with an attack or effect before the end of your turn, you lose invisibility.

abilities.warioNote: For those moments when you need to vanish without a trace! Just $1 in AP, and you're gone!

abilities.name: Commanding Salute
abilities.description: Lead your allies with a swift gesture, granting them temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable support boost at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: The ability unlocks early as it provides immediate support in combat.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you take a short rest
rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier. Ends if you fall unconscious.
rules.drawback: You must use your action on your turn for the next round.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a little salute... but it’ll keep ‘em going until you can act again!

abilities.name: Toad's Shield
abilities.description: Create a temporary shield of mud to block one attack, reducing damage by half or taking it yourself.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge at low levels.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can improvise basic defenses quickly in dangerous situations.

rules.effect: When you take damage from an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by half. If you do not have enough hit points left after taking reduced damage, you instead take all of it.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Toad's Shield? It’s just mud, but it works in a pinch! Bet it’s not as fancy as those other shields, but hey, it’s free!

abilities.name: Shield Stomp
abilities.description: Stomp your shield into an opponent, dealing bludgeoning damage and knocking them prone.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat move for level 1 that offers a quick and effective way to grapple an opponent or disrupt their movement.
abilities.levelReason: Militia receive basic combat training early in their career.

rules.effect: You make a melee attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone and take 1d8 + Constitution modifier bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: If you miss with Shield Stomp, you cannot use it again until after your next short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! This one's a stomp you can rely on, but if it misses? You're out of stomps 'til tomorrow. Cheap, right?

abilities.name: Tool Fortify
abilities.description: Increase your Tool proficiency bonus by one for 1 hour, but you must make a DC 8 + Proficiency + Dexterity saving throw.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant boost to tool proficiency at level 1 without being overly powerful.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often need to quickly enhance their tool skills in emergencies.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Proficiency + Dexterity. On failure, you lose the benefit of this ability for the next short rest.
rules.drawback: You must make a DC 8 + Proficiency + Dexterity saving throw.

abilities.warioNote: Tool Fortify? Priceless! Boost your skills, but don't mess up or you’ll lose it!

abilities.name: Divine Insight
abilities.description: Gain insight into a creature within 30 feet, allowing you to add your Charisma modifier to any Wisdom (Perception) check made against it.
abilities.apReason: The ability provides immediate benefit without requiring resources or resting, making it cost one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking basic divine abilities at level 1 allows Paladins to assist in early encounters.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, you can add your Charisma modifier to one Wisdom (Perception) check against a creature within 30 feet. The effect ends when you make the check.
rules.drawback: You must spend an Action Surge before using Divine Insight again.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s just a little peek inside someone's head. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Shadowslick
abilities.description: Gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 minute by becoming slippery with shadowy substance.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 1 that helps Rogues navigate stealth challenges effectively.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking stealthy maneuvers early helps Rogues outmaneuver foes.

rules.effect: Increase Dexterity (Stealth) checks by 2 until a short rest. Save DC 8 + proficiency + Dexterity modifier.
rules.drawback: Shadowy residue clings to your skin, reducing movement speed by 5 feet for the duration.

abilities.warioNote: It's slippery down there! Watch where you step!

abilities.name: Fury Surge
abilities.description: Gain +2 to attack and damage rolls for the next minute, but take a -1 penalty on Dexterity saving throws.
abilities.apReason: A level 1-4 ability providing a small reliable edge and temporary boost to combat prowess at 1 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlockable at level 1 as a small reliable edge.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, you gain +2 to attack and damage rolls until the start of your next turn. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or knocked unconscious. You take a -1 penalty on Dexterity saving throws while the effect is active.
rules.drawback: Temporary reduction in Dexterity saving throw success rate.

abilities.warioNote: Fury Surge? Why not just say you’re in a rage, right? Easy +2, hard -1. You’re welcome.

abilities.name: Arcane Cipher
abilities.description: Recite a hidden spell in code, delivering it as a surprise with no verbal component.
abilities.apReason: It grants a powerful, at-will magic ability for minimal cost.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards can start applying their arcane knowledge immediately to enhance spells.

rules.effect: When casting a spell, you may use Arcane Cipher. The spell cannot be detected as verbal or read with divination until it is spoken aloud. You must make a DC 8 + Intelligence modifier Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the spell fails to take effect.
rules.drawback: You risk failing the spell if your target detects its arcane nature before you finish reciting it.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Want to pull one over on the DM? This one’s a winner!

abilities.name: Shieldslash
abilities.description: Deal an additional 1d6 slashing damage on your melee attacks.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable combat edge at level 1 without being overpowered.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters unlock basic combat abilities early to enhance their prowess in close combat.

rules.effect: On a melee attack, add 1d6 slashing damage.
rules.drawback: Reduces your armor class by 2 until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Got this Shieldslam for just one AP? It'll slice through those enemies like butter, but watch out—your defenses take a hit!

abilities.name: Bullet Dance
abilities.description: Quickly reload and fire a burst of bullets, dealing 1d8+Dex modifier fire damage.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge, justifying the cost of 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 provides an early offensive edge for the Gunslinger.

rules.effect: 1d8+Dexterity modifier fire damage. Must have a loaded firearm in hand.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if reloading would exceed your speed.

abilities.warioNote: Bullet Dance? More like ‘bullet drain’! Watch your ammo, it goes fast!

abilities.name: Shadowcast
abilities.description: Conceal your spellcasting in shadowy darkness to confuse enemies and grant advantage on attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability that provides a reliable combat edge at low levels.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to cast spells without drawing attention.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you leave a dark space
rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls while in darkness. This effect ends if you enter an area with direct light.
rules.drawback: You must remain in shadowy areas to maintain this effect.

abilities.warioNote: Pay for the illusion of stealth, you say? Well, it's not like you're getting unlimited shadows or anything!

abilities.name: Inspiring Command
abilities.description: Boost an ally's attack by +2 damage and grant advantage on their next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: This ability provides a significant benefit to an ally, justifying its cost as an action point.
abilities.levelReason: Leadership abilities are most impactful at level 1 to support the party immediately.

rules.duration: Until the end of the next short rest
rules.effect: Choose an ally within reach. The target's next attack roll before the start of your next turn has advantage and deals +2 extra damage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used on yourself or if you are incapacitated.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, I let your buddy look like they're hitting harder and more accurately. What do you mean it's too much?

abilities.name: Toss and Run
abilities.description: Quickly toss an improvised weapon and dash away, dodging a potential attack.
abilities.apReason: A quick, resourceful ability that costs a small AP to leverage in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners need to defend themselves with limited resources.

rules.effect: Make a ranged attack against an enemy within 20 feet. On a hit, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + Dexterity modifier) or be disarmed and you move away 10 feet.
rules.drawback: You are unarmed until after your next action.

abilities.warioNote: It's like... throwing your shoe and running away! Who knew you could be so sneaky?

abilities.name: Mace Shield
abilities.description: Deal an additional bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier when you bash an enemy with a shield.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that grants additional damage at no cost.
abilities.levelReason: Basic training allows the militia to harness their basic combat skills for simple attacks.

rules.effect: When you use a reaction to bash an enemy with your shield, deal 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this reaction if you are not wearing light armor.

abilities.warioNote: It’s just a little extra oomph behind your bash, but hey, it packs quite the punch!

abilities.name: Master Craftsman
abilities.description: As a bonus action, you can improve an improvised weapon or tool, granting it +1d6 damage until your next long rest.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge, unlocking at level 1 to give Artisans a versatile tool for their kit.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans need small advantages to maximize their utility from the get-go.

rules.effect: The improvised weapon or tool deals an additional 1d6 damage. Save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability on the same item more than once per day.

abilities.warioNote: It's just one little boost... but it's gonna make your tools sing like a bird!

abilities.name: Divine Rebuke
abilities.description: Call down a burst of divine flame upon an enemy within range, dealing radiant damage and forcing a saving throw.
abilities.apReason: A reliable combat move that can force saves and knock enemies down, useful at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can call on their faith to intervene from early in their training.

rules.effect: You hurl a burst of divine flame at one creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d6 radiant damage and must succeed on a DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone.
rules.drawback: You must use an action to prepare for this ability each short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! For just one AP, you get to burn a critter with holy fire. What's not to love?

abilities.name: Shade Leap
abilities.description: Disappear into a shadowy blur, then reappear next to an enemy for a swift strike.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 1, allowing for quick repositioning and attacks.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues learn basic stealth maneuvers early in their training.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, adjacent to a hostile creature. You have advantage on the first attack roll against that target made before the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: You must end your movement within reach of the target or it ends its turn immediately.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just a little Shadow Step, but it gets you where you need to be in a hurry! Just don't use it too close to your allies...

abilities.name: Berserker Roar
abilities.description: Shout a primal battlecry, imposing disadvantage on enemies within 30 feet who can hear you.
abilities.apReason: A combat utility that grants a short-term advantage but risks exhaustion, unlocking at level 1 as a reliable edge.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians channel their fury early to gain an immediate combat advantage.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you use a bonus action on your turn
rules.effect: Enemies within range have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. Ends when the effect ends or if you take damage.
rules.drawback: You must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw after each long rest to avoid becoming exhausted.

abilities.warioNote: It's loud... and it makes you tired. But worth it for that extra roar!

abilities.name: Arcane Mirage
abilities.description: Create a shifting mirage of yourself to confuse and mislead enemies.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards often face small threats that can overwhelm them early on.

rules.effect: Create an illusory duplicate of yourself within range. Creatures that fail a DC 8 + Intelligence modifier Wisdom saving throw are confused for 1 round.
rules.drawback: The mirage is only as convincing as your performance, and it can be dispelled with a successful Arcana check.

abilities.warioNote: It's like magic, but cheaper than renting a magician!

abilities.name: Shield Spike
abilities.description: On your bonus action, you can spike your shield to deal 1d6 damage to a creature within reach.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide players with small reliable edges that can be used strategically in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to use their shields in combat at an early level.

rules.effect: You make a melee weapon attack with your shield. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 piercing damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Shield Spike if you are not wielding a shield.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, this training gives your shield a little extra bite! What could be better?

abilities.name: Bullet Speed
abilities.description: The Gunslinger's reload speed increases, allowing them to chamber a new round instantly.
abilities.apReason: At level 1, this provides a reliable combat edge that can be used frequently without draining resources.
abilities.levelReason: At level 1, the Gunslinger has just started mastering their firearms.

rules.effect: The Gunslinger can reload a firearm as part of a bonus action, ending when the reload is complete.
rules.drawback: After using Bullet Speed, you are hindered for 1 minute and must make a DC 8 Constitution saving throw at the start of each short rest or become fatigued until then.

abilities.warioNote: Sure it's quick, but your hands might get all jittery after!

abilities.name: Shade Dive
abilities.description: Briefly become a living shadow to slip through tight spaces or evade attacks.
abilities.apReason: It provides a significant tactical advantage at the cost of mobility during its duration.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to navigate tight, unorthodox spaces.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you move more than 30 feet
rules.effect: You become a living shadow for the duration. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide and can pass through any space as small as one-quarter your size without squeezing.
rules.drawback: While in this form, you are prone and cannot take reactions.

abilities.warioNote: Now you can sneak through tiny cracks! Just don't expect to be too spry after using it!

abilities.name: Unified Charge
abilities.description: Inspire your allies to charge forward with a bellow, granting them advantage on attack rolls for the next minute.
abilities.apReason: Provides a strong combat support benefit at level 1 for 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders are often called upon to boost their allies' morale early in combat.

rules.effect: All allies within 30 feet of you gain advantage on attack rolls. This ends if the target of your command takes any damage.
rules.drawback: While this effect lasts, you must remain within 30 feet of an ally who benefits from it.

abilities.warioNote: Unified Charge? More like 'Unite and Charge!' This one's got you covered, even if your friends run right into danger.

abilities.name: Toad Slam
abilities.description: Deal 1d8+2 bludgeoning damage to a creature within reach with your improvised weapon.
abilities.apReason: It provides a reliable combat option for level 1 Commoners using improvised weapons.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can use improvised weapons and benefit from basic combat techniques early on.

rules.effect: You make a melee weapon attack against one creature within reach. On a hit, you deal 1d8+2 bludgeoning damage.
rules.drawback: This ability does not benefit from proficiency and only affects creatures within reach.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it’s free, but watch your toad’s paws—it might slip!

abilities.name: Defensive Shield
abilities.description: Increase your shield's effectiveness, granting an additional +1 bonus to AC for yourself.
abilities.apReason: Enhancing one's defensive posture is a small reliable edge for level 1 characters.
abilities.levelReason: Basic training in defensive techniques allows the Militia to enhance their shield use.

rules.duration: Until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: You gain a +1 bonus to AC until your next turn. This ends if you take damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, just another way to beef up your defense! Can't have you getting too tough, now can we?

abilities.name: Tool Proficiency Boost
abilities.description: Gain proficiency with any tool of your choice.
abilities.apReason: It grants immediate and substantial utility without stacking with any other abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans start with basic tool knowledge and can enhance it slightly at level 1.

rules.effect: Choose a new tool proficiency. This does not stack with other proficiencies gained through class features or feats.
rules.drawback: Once per short rest, you must forego another at-will ability to use this.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah right... like I care if you get a new tool. Just don't expect it for free!

abilities.name: Holy Shielding
abilities.description: Create a radiant barrier around yourself to absorb one attack per turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide small reliable edges that cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins start combat with basic defensive abilities like Holy Shielding.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: When you are attacked, roll a d10 + Cha modifier as an AC bonus. The attacker must make a successful DC 8 + Cha modifier saving throw or miss this attack.
rules.drawback: If you are hit by the attack, this ability is used up.

abilities.warioNote: Oh boy, want to buy some Holy Shielding? It's like a little shield that shows you're divine. But hey, only lasts one turn and you can't use it twice in the same fight.

abilities.name: Bestial Roar
abilities.description: Roar at enemies, forcing them to make a Wisdom save or be stunned for one round.
abilities.apReason: Unleashing a powerful combat maneuver at will costs one Ability Point, fitting its level and utility.
abilities.levelReason: Unleashing raw primal power is within the reach of a level 1 barbarian.

rules.duration: instantaneous effect, lasts until end of next turn for each creature stunned
rules.effect: Each creature within 30 feet of the barbarian must make a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for one minute. The effect ends if the stunned creature takes any action.
rules.drawback: The barbarian cannot use this ability while in the effects of another bestial roar.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having a pack of wolves at your command—just without the cleanup!

abilities.name: Arcane Whistle
abilities.description: 吹响魔杖，瞬发法术，召唤一只元素生物助战。
abilities.apReason: 瞬发召唤，但效果有限，适合初学者尝试。
abilities.levelReason: 初学者能掌握简单的元素控制技巧。

rules.effect: 施法者召唤一只低级元素生物（如火元素、风元素），持续1轮。被召唤的生物攻击附近的敌方单位，每轮造成1d6+智力修正的伤害，并在回合结束时返回施法者身边。
rules.drawback: 只能召唤低级元素生物，且无法控制其行为，在战斗中可能会产生意外结果。

abilities.warioNote: 这根魔杖的音符可不简单哦！就一个铜板，让你的小元素朋友来帮忙打怪！

abilities.name: Shieldsplitter
abilities.description: Deal double damage on a critical hit with a shield.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 1 that offers a significant boost when critical hits are achieved.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters at level 1 are learning to harness the power of their shields effectively.

rules.effect: If this attack would score a critical hit, deal double damage. The effect ends if the fighter is incapacitated.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used with any shield not specifically designed for bash attacks.

abilities.warioNote: For a few zillion AP, you can turn your shield into a weapon of legend... or at least double damage on crits!

abilities.name: Rapid Shot
abilities.description: Fire two additional bullets as a bonus action, but your next attack roll is disadvantageous.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge that can change one encounter beat.
abilities.levelReason: At this level, the gunslinger can afford to risk one shot for the chance of landing more damage.

rules.effect: You fire two additional bullets as a bonus action. On your next attack roll, you have disadvantage. This ability costs no ammo.
rules.drawback: Your next attack roll is at disadvantage.

abilities.warioNote: Rapid Shot? What's so rapid about two measly bullets? And don't get me started on the fact you miss your next shot!

abilities.name: Shadow Blend
abilities.description: Merge into shadows for +10 feet movement speed and advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge for early game, useful for both movement and stealth.
abilities.levelReason: Spies need to move undetected early in their career.

rules.effect: While active, movement speed increases by 10 feet and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Ends if concentration is lost.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used again until after a short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: Who needs super speed when you can blend into the shadows!

abilities.name: Commanding Hand
abilities.description: Extend your reach to aid an ally within 30 feet, granting them advantage on their next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for a leader at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: A leader can immediately offer support when needed in combat.

rules.effect: Target gains advantage on their next attack roll. The effect ends if the target attacks another creature before their next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's just an arm, but it can save the day! For only 1 AP!

abilities.name: Steadfast Stance
abilities.description: Gain advantage on saving throws against fear effects until you take damage or a short rest.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that can turn the tide in close combat without requiring resource-intensive actions.
abilities.levelReason: Basic training in defensive tactics allows for early confidence in facing threats head-on.

rules.duration: until you take damage or a short rest
rules.effect: You gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened. This ends when you take damage or complete a short rest.
rules.drawback: While active, you cannot use reactions to aid allies.

abilities.warioNote: For just a few coins, you get more courage than all your friends combined! What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Tool Adaptation
abilities.description: Quickly repurpose tools into makeshift weapons or defenses, dealing 1d6 + Intelligence modifier bludgeoning damage.
abilities.apReason: At level 1, this ability provides a useful combat tool at the cost of one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans can swiftly adapt to combat situations with basic tools at level 1.

rules.effect: When you use this ability, choose a tool within reach. You can either deal 1d6 + Intelligence modifier bludgeoning damage with it as a weapon or gain a +2 bonus to AC for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: You cannot use Tool Adaptation if you are wearing armor.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Ever need to turn your wrench into a weapon? Now you can with Tool Adaptation! Just don't go around making armor out of spoons...

abilities.name: Divine Barrier
abilities.description: Create a shimmering barrier around yourself that absorbs damage for you or those nearby.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability with a short rest use and a minor penalty makes this a reliable edge for early play.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins often use their divine power to protect others early in their training.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until the barrier is destroyed
rules.effect: The barrier provides a +2 bonus to AC and reduces damage taken by up to 5 (d6) for you and one ally within 30 feet. The effect ends if you lose consciousness.
rules.drawback: While the barrier is active, your movement speed is reduced by 10 feet.

abilities.warioNote: You think you’re tough? Try standing still for a minute under fire!

abilities.name: Shade Dash
abilities.description: Teleport a short distance, evading attacks during the movement.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 1, allowing for quick escapes and repositioning.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues gain mobility and stealth advantages early in their training.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 15 feet, ending in an unoccupied space. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made before this movement.
rules.drawback: You must move at least half the distance of your movement speed.

abilities.warioNote: Need a shortcut? Don't worry, this little dash won't leave you behind!

abilities.name: Fury Dash
abilities.description: Leap into battle, gaining advantage on attack rolls until you take damage.
abilities.apReason: A quick and effective combat maneuver that gives immediate tactical advantage at low cost.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians need to close in quickly for their rage.

rules.effect: Until you take damage, your attack rolls have advantage. This ends if you are incapacitated or stunned.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate to maintain the effect; failing a concentration check ends it immediately.

abilities.warioNote: Run like the wind! Just don't trip, or you'll fall flat on your face!

abilities.name: Arcane Illusion
abilities.description: Create a convincing visual illusion to mislead or distract enemies within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability that provides a minor tactical advantage.
abilities.levelReason: Starting wizards can perform minor illusions.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Intelligence modifier (Arcane Illusion check to see through it)
rules.drawback: +2 penalty on all Arcana checks for the rest of the day.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, why not? It’s just an illusion... but it’ll mess with their minds!

abilities.name: Steady Strike
abilities.description: Increase your damage by +1d6 on a single melee attack.
abilities.apReason: It provides a reliable edge in combat at low levels.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to focus their strikes with precision at level 1.

rules.effect: When you make a melee attack, add +1d6 damage to the roll. This effect ends if you miss with this attack.
rules.drawback: You can only activate Steady Strike once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah, it’s just one little dice roll. But that’s all the focus you need to get through your next fight!

abilities.name: Shadow Swipe
abilities.description: Quickly disarm or disable a single light weapon with a deft hand.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at level 1 that allows for quick and decisive action without expending resources.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to disarm opponents quickly and quietly.

rules.effect: You make a Dexterity (Stealth) check contested by the target's Strength (Athletics). On a success, you disarm or disable their light weapon. The effect ends if your concentration is broken.
rules.drawback: The ability has a -5 penalty if used against a creature with proficiency in Athletics.

abilities.warioNote: It's like picking your opponent's pocket... but legally!

abilities.name: Battle Cry
abilities.description: Shout a rallying cry to boost allies' morale, granting them advantage on attack rolls until their next action.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability providing a reliable morale boost, worth 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Leaders inspire others from an early age by rallying troops and boosting morale.

rules.duration: until the start of each ally's next turn after this use
rules.effect: Allies within 60 feet gain advantage on attack rolls. Ends if they move out of range.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used again until a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's like giving your team a high-five... and then they fight better! Only one per break though...

abilities.name: Cheap Shot
abilities.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage with any improvised weapon.
abilities.apReason: A combat ability that aids in damage output at no cost is worth one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can leverage basic tools into effective attacks.

rules.effect: On a hit, deal an extra 1d6 damage with any improvised weapon. The target can make a DC 8 + proficiency + Dexterity modifier saving throw to negate this effect.
rules.drawback: You must be proficient in the improvised weapon used.

abilities.warioNote: Hey, even a toad can pack some extra punch with the right tool!

abilities.name: Tool Craft
abilities.description: Create an improvised weapon or tool as a bonus action, dealing 1d6 damage.
abilities.apReason: An immediate combat utility that costs one AP to create an effective but disposable weapon.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans start with basic crafting skills they can apply immediately.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier for a successful check; on failure, the tool breaks and deals no damage.
rules.drawback: The improvised weapon or tool is destroyed after use.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, buy this and you can make your own toy sword! Don't mind if it breaks after a hit—only one AP, right?

abilities.name: Divine Resolve
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1) until you take damage.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge, and Divine Resolve grants temporary hit points on demand without additional actions or costs.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain temporary hit points as a core feature at level 1.

rules.effect: You gain 1d8 + Cha modifier temporary hit points. This effect ends when you take damage.
rules.drawback: This ability does not stack with other sources of temporary hit points.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a little extra armor... for free! But hey, you still gotta take that damage eventually.

abilities.name: Shadow Sprint
abilities.description: Take a short rest to dash forward, leaving an invisible mark on your path.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks as Rogues gain the ability to take short rests during combat.

rules.effect: You may move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks. On the ground, leave a faint shadowy trail that lasts for 1 minute.
rules.drawback: The shadow trail can be detected by any creature with blindsense or darkvision.

abilities.warioNote: It's like teleporting... but only for a second! And it leaves a mark. Genius!

abilities.name: Bloodied Rampage
abilities.description: On your turn after taking damage, gain advantage on your next attack roll but suffer a -2 penalty to AC until your next short rest.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a reliable edge for new players.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians channel their rage early in combat to maximize their effectiveness.

rules.duration: until end of next short rest
rules.effect: Gain advantage on your next attack roll. You suffer a -2 penalty to AC until your next short rest.
rules.drawback: While gaining the benefit, you are vulnerable in combat.

abilities.warioNote: Feel the burn... and the vulnerability!

abilities.name: Rapid Strike
abilities.description: Gain an extra attack with a martial weapon as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities typically cost 1 AP and this adds a reliable combat edge early in the game.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters gain the ability to make more attacks at level 1.

rules.effect: You gain an additional attack with any martial weapon as a bonus action. This does not provoke opportunity attacks.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: Lookin' for an extra punch? This'll set ya back just one AP, but trust me—it's worth it!

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description: Draws a firearm from a holster, ready to shoot, as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: Draws a weapon as a bonus action, giving combat flexibility at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: The Gunslinger starts their journey with the basics of quick reflexes and weapon readiness.

rules.effect: Draws a firearm from a holster, ready to shoot. The Gunslinger can make an attack with the drawn weapon as their next action.
rules.drawback: Cannot draw and attack in the same turn without expending 1 additional bonus action.

abilities.warioNote: Quick with the quid! For just one AP, you can be ready to shoot without wasting time!

abilities.name: Shade Shift
abilities.description: Merge with shadows to become nearly invisible for a short time.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge at level 1 without being overpowered for the cost of one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to move undetected at their earliest level.

rules.effect: You become nearly invisible until the start of your next turn. You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and are considered difficult terrain for others while in this state. This effect ends if you attack or cast a spell.
rules.drawback: While in this state, you cannot use any action that requires concentration.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like blending into the night! Or rather, not standing out. Just remember, you can’t do any focused magic tricks while invisible!

abilities.name: Sentry's Vigil
abilities.description: You create a defensive shield of energy around an ally, granting them temporary hit points.
abilities.apReason: Support abilities at level 1 typically cost 1 AP and provide a small but reliable benefit.
abilities.levelReason: At level 1, you have the basic skills to protect allies effectively.

rules.duration: Until the end of your next turn or when a creature successfully hits the ally with an attack
rules.effect: The chosen ally gains 3 temporary hit points. The effect ends if that ally is reduced to 0 HP.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability on yourself.

abilities.warioNote: Sentry's Vigil? No, we don't need no stinkin' shield! But it'll keep your friend alive just long enough to say ‘I told ya so’!

abilities.name: Cheap Alchemy
abilities.description: Craft a simple potion or alchemical item as if you had the required proficiency and ingredients.
abilities.apReason: Crafting an item without materials or proficiency is a useful but not overwhelming ability for level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners often assist in crafting mundane items for sale.

rules.effect: You may create one potion or alchemical item of your choice that doesn't require a material component. No saving throw is required.
rules.drawback: The success rate of the created item is halved.

abilities.warioNote: It's just alchemy, nothing too fancy... right?

abilities.name: Reload Ready
abilities.description: Quickly reload your firearm, gaining a bonus action to attack immediately after reloading.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge that allows quick response during combat.
abilities.levelReason: Militia often need to reload quickly between engagements.

rules.effect: When you finish a bonus action to reload a simple firearm, you can make an attack with it as part of the same bonus action.
rules.drawback: You must have a simple firearm in hand and spend an additional 1d4 seconds to ensure proper reloading.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah, reload faster! And don't forget to pay the extra time it takes!

abilities.name: Quick Fix
abilities.description: Create a functional tool as an improvised weapon, dealing 1d6 + DEX damage.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge, and this grants the ability to quickly use tools as weapons.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans often face unexpected challenges and need to act quickly.

rules.effect: You create a functional tool that can be used as an improvised weapon. It deals 1d6 + DEX damage on a hit.
rules.drawback: The created tool cannot be used for crafting or repair tasks.

abilities.warioNote: Sure thing, pal! Just don't expect it to last long after you break it in combat!

abilities.name: Holy Watch
abilities.description: Gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed until your next short rest.
abilities.apReason: This passive support ability provides consistent benefit and is unlocked early for utility in combat scenarios.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can start using minor support abilities early in their career.

rules.effect: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed. This ends when you complete a short rest.
rules.drawback: While under the effect, you cannot gain further advantage from other sources.

abilities.warioNote: Sure, it's just a little shield around your wits, but it’s a cheap one! It’s like getting an extra layer of cheese on your pizza—essential!

abilities.name: Shade Glide
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows for a moment, then reappear behind an enemy.
abilities.apReason: Provides a tactical advantage at low cost, enhancing combat effectiveness without overpowered abilities.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues at level 1 can start to manipulate the battlefield with their movement.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on attack rolls against a creature you have used this ability on within the last minute. The target can make an Intelligence saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier) to resist being flanked by you.
rules.drawback: If the target succeeds on its save, it is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

abilities.warioNote: Watch out—your enemies might just vanish and reappear right behind you! Priceless, isn't it?

abilities.name: Raging Howl
abilities.description: Bellow a fearsome cry to grant temporary hit points equal to your Barbarian level + Con modifier.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities are small reliable edges that cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians can harness primal energy from the start of combat.

rules.duration: 1 minute or until you take damage
rules.effect: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Barbarian level + your Con modifier.
rules.drawback: You must finish a long rest before using Raging Howl again.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah, it's like giving yourself a little health boost just by yelling really loud. What could go wrong?

abilities.name: Arcane Vortex
abilities.description: Create a swirling maelstrom that deals lightning damage to enemies within its radius.
abilities.apReason: It provides a tactical advantage with limited resources at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: A beginning wizard can afford to experiment with small-scale area effects.

rules.effect: Create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-high conical area of swirling air. Enemies within it take 3d6 lightning damage. A successful DC 10 Dexterity saving throw halves the damage and ends the effect early.
rules.drawback: You must concentrate on maintaining the vortex for its duration.

abilities.warioNote: Pay one AP to summon a mini-storm. It’s like having your own weather control!

abilities.name: Counterbladework
abilities.description: Exchange damage for an opponent's. Redirect one melee attack to their ally.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that grants tactical flexibility at a cost.
abilities.levelReason: Fighters at level 1 can start thinking tactically about their foes.

rules.effect: You take the attack directed at you and redirect it to an adjacent ally within 5 feet. The target of the redirected attack makes a DC 10 + proficiency modifier + Strength modifier saving throw. On a failure, they take the original damage from the redirected attack; on success, no one takes any damage.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability more than once per short rest.

abilities.warioNote: For just 1 AP, you get to mess with your enemies' plans. But only once! Who knew redirecting attacks could be so tricky?

abilities.name: Bullet Waltz
abilities.description: Quickly reload and fire twice in rapid succession, bypassing cover while drawing your firearm.
abilities.apReason: Offers a combat advantage at level 1 for gunslingers who need quick offensive options.
abilities.levelReason: Gunslingers start with the basics of quick draw and reloading.

rules.effect: Make two attacks as if you had a total of four firearms in hand. You can bypass cover to make these attacks, but you cannot attack through objects larger than your target.
rules.drawback: You must reload all firearms after using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: It's like a dance, but with bullets! Just don't mess up the steps or you'll be reloading all night!

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.description: You become nearly invisible, gaining advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for a minute.
abilities.apReason: Provides an ongoing benefit at the low cost of one Ability Point.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often use stealth to gather information and avoid detection.

rules.effect: You gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Ends if you attack or cast a spell with verbal components.
rules.drawback: While active, you can't take reactions.

abilities.warioNote: It's like having your own personal invisibility cloak... for a buck!

abilities.name: Guiding Light
abilities.description: You emit a soft glow that grants allies within 10 feet advantage on saving throws.
abilities.apReason: Guiding Light offers a small but reliable support ability that helps allies, unlocking at level 1 as expected.
abilities.levelReason: As a leader, you start to inspire your allies from the moment you step into battle.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on saving throws. Ends when you lose concentration.
rules.drawback: You must use your bonus action each round.

abilities.warioNote: For just 1 AP, you can make your friends feel all warm and fuzzy! Or at least, less likely to fall over.

abilities.name: Toad's Trickery
abilities.description: Create a misdirection to confuse foes, gaining advantage on your next attack roll.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge for level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Basic commoners can use simple tricks to their advantage.

rules.effect: When you are attacked, you may use your reaction to create a misdirection. Until the start of your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls.
rules.drawback: The trick only works once per encounter.

abilities.warioNote: It's just a toad trick... but it might work!

abilities.name: Rapid Load
abilities.description: Draw two light weapons as a bonus action, then make two attacks with them.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a reliable edge with minimal cost.
abilities.levelReason: Militia have basic training in handling simple weapons efficiently.

rules.effect: Draws two light weapons and makes two attacks with them. If either attack misses, you can't use this ability again until the start of your next turn.
rules.drawback: If an attack misses, you cannot use Rapid Load until the start of your next turn.

abilities.warioNote: Rapidly reload? Sure! But don't expect it to work if that last shot missed.

abilities.name: Masterful Finesse
abilities.description: Increase your Dexterity (Tool Proficiency) check by 2d6, but only on tools you are proficient with.
abilities.apReason: Level 1-4 abilities cost 1 AP and this is a reliable edge for Artisans at this level.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks at level 1 as a small reliable edge for Artisans.

rules.effect: When making an attack or ability check with a tool you are proficient in, add 2d6 to the roll. This effect ends when you no longer have proficiency with the tool.
rules.drawback: Only applies to tools you are proficient with.

abilities.warioNote: These tools are sharpened, not sold. Only the best for your craft!

abilities.name: Radiant Barrier
abilities.description: Create a shimmering barrier of light that reduces incoming damage by half for one minute.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities should be small reliable edges that cost one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can start using simple defensive abilities early in their training.

rules.effect: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against all damage until the end of your next turn. DC 10 + proficiency + Wisdom modifier.
rules.drawback: You cannot cast divine smite while this ability is active.

abilities.warioNote: For just a single AP, you get to pretend you're a god for a minute! What more could you ask?

abilities.name: Shadow Dash
abilities.description: On your move, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space.
abilities.apReason: This ability allows for a critical tactical reposition at no cost, making it a reliable edge in combat.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues at level 1 need a reliable way to escape and reposition without triggering attacks of opportunity.

rules.effect: You teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within range. You must have line of effect from your starting point to the ending point.
rules.drawback: If you move into hostile territory, you provoke opportunity attacks as normal.

abilities.warioNote: Oh sure, Shadow Dash. Makes you invisible... for about two seconds before you trip on your own shadow.

abilities.name: Fury Leap
abilities.description: Leap into the fray, gaining +2 to attack rolls and damage until you miss or take damage.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities should provide a small reliable edge that costs little but can be used often.
abilities.levelReason: Barbarians need ways to close distance quickly in their early levels.

rules.duration: until you miss or take damage
rules.effect: When you activate, gain +2 to attack rolls and damage until you miss an attack roll or take damage. This ends if you use another reaction this turn.
rules.drawback: Can only be used once per round.

abilities.warioNote: Jump into the fray? Sure, for just one AP! But watch out—your feet might get tired!

abilities.name: Whispered Spell
abilities.description: Conjure a non-verbal arcane signal, granting advantage on a spell check to cast an incantation.
abilities.apReason: A small reliable edge at level 1 justifies its 1 AP cost.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks as the wizard gains their first spellcasting ability.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: When you cast a verbal spell, you can use an action to create a non-verbal signal. On your next turn when you make a spell check for casting that spell, you gain advantage.
rules.drawback: You must declare the spell and the intended target before using this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey, it's not just for sneaky rogues! Get an unfair edge in spellcasting with this one!

abilities.name: Snap Kick
abilities.description: Quickly follow up a heavy attack with an additional kick that deals 1d6+STR modifier bludgeoning damage.
abilities.apReason: A quick follow-up is a small reliable edge that costs one Ability Point.
abilities.levelReason: Beginner fighters learn to capitalize on their momentum after a successful strike.

rules.effect: On your turn, immediately after hitting with an attack roll, you can use this bonus action to make a kick for 1d6 + STR modifier bludgeoning damage. The effect ends if you miss the initial attack.
rules.drawback: You cannot perform Snap Kick unless your initial attack hits.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting a free extra hit! Just make sure your first punch lands!

abilities.name: Shade Step
abilities.description: Disappear into shadows, teleporting to an unoccupied space within 30 feet.
abilities.apReason: A reliable and immediate edge in reconnaissance and escape, fitting the level.
abilities.levelReason: Spies often need to move quickly and quietly without being detected.

rules.effect: Teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 feet. Must be in dim light or darkness. Cannot end inside a creature.
rules.drawback: You leave behind a trace of your shadow, which can be used for tracking.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like disappearing into thin air... or at least into the shadows. Cheap, but effective!

abilities.name: Inspire Rally
abilities.description: Shout a rallying cry that grants an ally within 30 feet advantage on attack rolls.
abilities.apReason: Inspire Rally is a support ability that grants immediate, situational advantage on rolls at the cost of an AP.
abilities.levelReason: Leader's presence is most felt as they inspire their allies in their first combat.

rules.duration: until the start of your next turn
rules.effect: An ally within range can make an attack roll with advantage. Ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must be visible to all allies for this ability to function.

abilities.warioNote: Don't worry, your friends will fight harder... but you'll be out one shiny coin.

abilities.name: Cheap Potion
abilities.description: Concoct a simple potion with 1 hour of concentration, providing minor healing or utility effects.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge that can be used frequently.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can start to use basic alchemy at level 1.

rules.effect: Create a potion that restores 2d4+Charisma modifier hit points. Saves against the effect are DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: The potion lasts only until consumed, and the alchemist must spend 10 gp to make it.

abilities.warioNote: This cheap potion is just as good as those fancy wizard spells, but it costs gold! Can’t we have some free stuff?

abilities.name: Mighty Smash
abilities.description: Smash an enemy with your shield, dealing force damage equal to your Strength modifier + proficiency bonus.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge at the start of combat, providing immediate threat.
abilities.levelReason: Basic combat training allows for rudimentary weapon use.

rules.effect: You deal force damage equal to your STR modifier + proficiency bonus. DC 8 + STR modifier + proficiency bonus for a saving throw.
rules.drawback: Cannot be used if you are not wielding a shield.

abilities.warioNote: For those days when your sword's just outta reach—mighty smash can turn any old shield into a weapon!

abilities.name: Forgebond Focus
abilities.description: Increase your tool proficiency check by +2d6 until you attack or take damage.
abilities.apReason: Provides a reliable edge at level 1 with no permanent benefit.
abilities.levelReason: Artisans start with the basics of crafting and need a way to quickly enhance their work.

rules.duration: until you attack or take damage
rules.effect: Proficiency bonus +2d6 on your next tool use. Save DC is 8 + proficiency modifier + Intelligence modifier.
rules.drawback: Once used, it cannot be activated again until after a short rest.

abilities.warioNote: Yeah right, like I’m selling you this for just one AP? It’s a toolmaster’s dream!

abilities.name: Holy Vigor
abilities.description: Gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier when you finish a short rest.
abilities.apReason: This is a reliable small edge that can be used at will, providing healing without costing any resources during combat.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins gain temporary hit points from their class features, so this ability fits naturally at level 1.

rules.effect: Gain 2 temporary hit points per point of Charisma modifier.
rules.drawback: You must complete a short rest to gain this ability's effect again.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like having a little extra juice in your battery pack—great for those tough moments!

abilities.name: Shade Slip
abilities.description: Disappear into shadowy obscurity, becoming undetectable for a brief moment.
abilities.apReason: Provides a significant tactical advantage for a low cost, fitting the level tier.
abilities.levelReason: Rogues at level 1 start to learn how to exploit shadows and darkness.

rules.effect: You become invisible until the end of your next turn. A successful DC 8 Dexterity saving throw ends this effect early.
rules.drawback: While undetectable, you can only move at half speed and cannot attack.

abilities.warioNote: It's just like disappearing into thin air... for a round. You better use it wisely!

abilities.name: Bloodied Roar
abilities.description: Roar to deal thunder damage equal to your Strength modifier + half your level, stunning nearby enemies for 1 round.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities provide a small reliable edge, and Bloodied Roar offers a potent combat advantage at the cost of a reaction.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows the Barbarian to leverage their strength in early encounters.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Strength modifier + proficiency save vs. being stunned for 1 round; ends on a successful save.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

abilities.warioNote: It's like getting your very own thunderstorm in your pocket... for 1 AP!

abilities.name: Arcane Enigma
abilities.description: Conjure a disorienting spell that forces creatures within range to make a Wisdom saving throw or be confused for one round.
abilities.apReason: A reliable edge that allows for strategic use in combat or exploration, unlocking at level one to offer immediate utility.
abilities.levelReason: New wizards can experiment with basic spells without the risk of more powerful effects.

rules.effect: DC 8 + Intelligence modifier. On a failed save, the target is confused until the start of its next turn.
rules.drawback: Cannot be cast if you are concentrating on another spell.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Need a little chaos? For just one AP, you can throw your foes into confusion!

abilities.name: Fury Slash
abilities.description: Gain an additional attack on your turn when bloodied.
abilities.apReason: Fury Slash provides a reliable combat edge at level 1 by adding an additional attack when needed, making it cost 1 AP.
abilities.levelReason: A new fighter unlocks with basic combat skills and the ability to add more damage in critical situations.

rules.effect: On a bonus action, you can make an additional melee attack if your hit point total is less than half of its maximum. This attack uses your highest ability modifier.
rules.drawback: You must use your bonus action for this attack and it cannot be used with other features that grant extra attacks.

abilities.warioNote: Need more damage? This one's for you! Just remember, you can't use it all day long!

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.description: Fire two additional rounds from a firearm as a bonus action.
abilities.apReason: This ability grants a reliable combat edge at level 1, costing only one Ability Point.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocks early to leverage the Gunslinger's primary weapon proficiency at level 1.

rules.effect: When you make a ranged attack with a firearm, you can fire two additional rounds as a bonus action. You must have ammunition for each round fired.
rules.drawback: You cannot use this ability if you are incapacitated or restrained.

abilities.warioNote: It's just two extra shots, what could go wrong? Right?

abilities.name: Commanding Gaze
abilities.description: You command allies within sight, granting them advantage on attack rolls and saving throws for the next minute.
abilities.apReason: A level 1 ability that offers immediate tactical advantage at no cost.
abilities.levelReason: A level 1 Leader is starting to find their voice in combat.

rules.effect: All allies within range gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. The effect ends early if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: You must use a bonus action each round to maintain this effect.

abilities.warioNote: It’s like giving your friends superpowers, but you have to keep waving your hand!

abilities.name: Cheap Brew
abilities.description: Craft a simple potion that heals 1d4+Charisma modifier hit points.
abilities.apReason: Crafting a potion is useful but limited to basic remedies, costing one AP.
abilities.levelReason: Commoners can start crafting basic remedies with limited resources.

rules.effect: DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma modifier save for half effect; ends on a successful save.
rules.drawback: Cannot create potions of higher tier than this ability.

abilities.warioNote: Hey there! Cheap Brew? Why not just buy a potion from me for only 1 AP? Save your gold!

abilities.name: Reload Swiftly
abilities.description: Quickly reload a simple weapon, gaining an additional shot before your next action.
abilities.apReason: Provides a combat edge, unlocking at the start of training.
abilities.levelReason: A basic militia can perform quick reloads as part of their training.

rules.effect: You gain an additional attack with a simple weapon before your next action. You must have at least one hand free to reload.
rules.drawback: You cannot reload or attack again until after your next action.

abilities.warioNote: These toads might be slow, but they can still pack a punch quick as a wink!

abilities.name: Divine Shield Wall
abilities.description: Create a wall of holy energy that grants you and an ally within 5 feet a +2 bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 abilities should cost 1 AP, and this provides a significant defensive boost.
abilities.levelReason: Paladins can create protective effects early in their career.

rules.duration: until the end of your next turn
rules.effect: You and an ally within 5 feet gain a +2 bonus to AC until the end of your next turn. This ends if you move more than 10 feet away from the target ally.
rules.drawback: The wall can only protect one target at a time.

abilities.warioNote: For just a buck? You get to turn yourself into a shield! Who needs armor anyway?

abilities.name: Rampage Charge
abilities.description: On your bonus action, charge into combat and deal an extra 1d6 damage with your next melee attack.
abilities.apReason: Rampage Charge provides a significant combat advantage for a single action point, making it cost-effective at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Unlocking at level 1 allows for early engagement in combat.

rules.effect: On the next melee attack, deal an extra 1d6 damage. Ends when you make another melee attack or disengage.
rules.drawback: Cannot be activated if you are already charging.

abilities.warioNote: For just one AP, you get to charge into battle like a rampaging beast! What more could you ask?

abilities.name: Arcane Veil
abilities.description: Create a shimmering mist that grants temporary cover and conceals your movements.
abilities.apReason: Level 1 ability that provides a temporary area effect at will with a drawback.
abilities.levelReason: Wizards at level 1 begin to experiment with basic illusions.

rules.effect: You create a shimmering veil that provides you and willing creatures within 5 feet of you total cover. The effect ends if you are incapacitated.
rules.drawback: While under the effect, you have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and saving throws.

abilities.warioNote: $1 AP? It's like having an invisible friend to hide you from danger!

abilities.name: Sharpshooter's Edge
abilities.description: Gain advantage on attack rolls with ranged weapons for 1 minute.
abilities.apReason: A bonus action that provides a significant combat advantage at level 1.
abilities.levelReason: Fights need to be able to improve their attacks early in the game.

rules.effect: Gain advantage on attack rolls with ranged weapons. Ends when you make an attack roll without advantage or if your concentration is broken.
rules.drawback: You cannot gain the benefit of Sharpshooter's Edge for 1 hour after taking damage.

abilities.warioNote: It's like aiming with both eyes wide open, but only once you’ve been hit today!
